Monday afternoon | Stuck below 80K, what would you rather do first?

BTC is currently around 78.2K. It touched an intraday high of about 78.9K but couldn’t hold, and has drifted back below the resistance zone. From the Asian afternoon into the hours before the US session, what’s most likely isn’t “getting the direction wrong”—it’s “running out of patience”: turning boredom into adding to a position, or treating a failed intraday high as a reason to reverse immediately.

My usual habit is to write down three things before deciding whether to act:
1) What’s still valid in today’s plan (including stop-loss and no-adding conditions)
2) What the failed intraday high means for my position (most of the time: don’t chase, don’t retaliate)
3) What minimum signal I need to wait for before changing my plan ahead of the US market open

This isn’t a call to buy or sell—just a reminder: below resistance, timing matters more than opinions.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 USDT control 1,000 USDT, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Let me explain it in plain English today.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 USDT in principal and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a position worth
1,000 USDT. If the coin’s price rises by 1%, you earn 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note that the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by around 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop—you can lose it all after a drop of around 10% (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

📰 BTCPay had just said it hadn’t been hacked, and then its public-facing version was suddenly hit: Why haven’t the risks of self-hosting gone away?

We talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. BTCPay Server discovered that someone was using an outdated version of the software to steal funds from hot wallets. This isn’t the first time, but this time the public-facing version was directly attacked. For people who use BTCPay, small businesses working with the Lightning Network, and anyone who wants to manage their own money, it’s a reminder: self-hosting really isn’t easy.

Why does this news matter?
The root cause is that many people choose the free version for convenience but forget to update the software. BTCPay’s self-hosting model is meant to free people from relying on centralized exchanges. But the problem is that free versions come with poor service and slow updates, and security vulnerabilities are addressed slowly. Like the recent decline in miners’ computing power and regulatory uncertainty, this incident is another reminder to “not be too naive—take responsibility for your own affairs.” What does this mean? The self-hosting model is still only reliable if users pay for support themselves.

Impact on the market
In the short term, it’s a reminder to BTC and ETH users: if you keep your money with yourself, someone needs to keep an eye on it. But in the long term, it won’t have much impact on the market landscape. Historically, thefts like this haven’t really transformed the industry as a whole. For example, when Binance’s hot wallet was previously robbed, the losses were ultimately covered by insurance. So, it won’t affect the overall trend; it’s just a lesson for people with poor security awareness.

THORChain node operators have paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and TRON. According to Cointelegraph, the trigger was a block reorganization vulnerability. My assessment: this pause primarily changes the friction involved in moving stolen funds, rather than directly blocking their flow. That assessment depends on the pause covering the relevant cross-chain routes and lasting long enough.

First, let’s separate facts from inferences. As a matter of fact, node operators initiated the pause, which covers assets on several major networks. Around the same time, CoinDesk reported that Bitcoin had recovered to around $79,000 as the market digested the major hacking incident. The material provided here contains no on-chain transfer data, so we cannot conclude whether the hackers were hindered or the funds were rerouted.

My observation is that the core value of cross-chain swaps is to quickly convert one asset into another and move it across networks. After the pause, addresses holding stolen assets that still want to use this route can only wait for service to resume or turn to slower routes with more steps. Increased friction does not mean funds cannot move, but each step adds time exposure and traceable on-chain activity. Conversely, the pause also freezes liquidity for legitimate users; the longer it takes to resume, the greater the impact on ordinary swap demand.

Based on this, three things are worth monitoring next: first, how long the pause lasts, to see whether it is a brief fix or an extended suspension; second, whether suspicious addresses switch routes; and third, whether swap volumes surge to make up for lost activity after service resumes. If the pause is lifted quickly and on-chain fund flows show no notable changes, the assessment that “friction has increased” should be given less weight. 📰 Solana Is Switching ATA Programs—How Much Money Does It Actually Save?

Solana has approved a proposal to upgrade p-ATA. That means you won’t have to use the old ATA program to store your tokens anymore; it’s being replaced with a new one. ChainCatcher on Binance Square says the main reason for the change is to save some computing power (Compute Units). Put simply, it means the blockchain has to do less work when your tokens move around.

Why does this news matter?
Put simply, this is Solana optimizing costs. Web3 is getting more popular, and everyone likes to do things on-chain, but every transaction the blockchain processes comes with a cost. The ATA program is Solana’s old way of storing and accessing tokens, but it can get a bit sluggish after years of use, especially when everyone is active at once. The new program is intended to make the whole system run more smoothly and lower costs. **What does this mean?** Solana is working to combine a better user experience with cost control. That’s a big deal for a public blockchain competing on high performance and low costs.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this change could make Solana’s token (SOL) more attractive, since people like cost-saving solutions. **But it’s unlikely to have much impact on BTC or ETH prices**, because this is an internal Solana optimization with little connection to the broader market. In the long run, if Solana really can lower costs, it could attract more users. But optimizations like this are common across the market, and the key question is whether Solana can stand out. **A historical comparison?** During the hashrate wars, everyone was also trying to save on electricity and costs, but the ones that survived did so because they had strong ecosystems.

How to approach it
💡 This move is a plus for SOL, but BTC and ETH are unlikely to react much in the short term. If SOL can hold support around $90, this optimization could eventually be reflected in its price. **This view would no longer hold if a major regulatory crackdown or another public blockchain suddenly overtakes Solana.**

Why is this news important?
As one of the largest privacy protocols in DeFi, Tornado Cash has operated on the edge of regulatory compliance since its launch. Hackers frequently use it to move funds, essentially taking advantage of the information gap between privacy-focused protocols and on-chain oversight. This 4,000 ETH transfer is cause for concern because:
- The sum is large enough to attract the attention of risk-control systems at multi-asset exchanges
- The hacker’s choice of Tornado Cash suggests they know the protocol may still have undiscovered vulnerabilities or exploitable methods
- Foresight News’s tracking capabilities show that regulators have already developed more advanced tracking technologies

Market impact
There is no immediate price impact, but over the long term, this could intensify regulatory scrutiny of DeFi privacy protocols:
- The market landscape may shift subtly, and products similar to Tornado Cash may face stricter KYC requirements
- Funds may move further underground, while compliant investors may be more inclined to choose on-chain assets that do not offer privacy protection
- There are few comparable historical cases, but the 2019 MakerDAO flash-loan hack suggests that regulators may investigate such activity for months

This kind of hacker fund transfer has a relatively minor effect on market sentiment. I’d barely finished writing the previous post when I had to change one line: Circle has acted too, so the previous post’s claim that “Circle hadn’t frozen a thing” is outdated.

This is a follow-up and a correction, filling in the gap left in the previous post (02:38): the Bitquery roundup cited there said “Circle hasn’t frozen anything; $4.29 million in USDC/EURC is still movable.” But that roundup’s data was current as of November 2 at 15:46 UTC. Circle acted after that: at 11:19 a.m. Eastern Time on November 2—that is, 00:19 on November 3 in Beijing time—on-chain records show Circle blacklisted a wallet holding about 708,000 USDC. That address is the incident-related target address publicly disclosed by the exchange itself.

Two independent sources agree: The Defiant stated directly that “on-chain records confirm Circle froze USDC on Polygon”; a KuCoin flash update relayed researcher Specter’s account of the same freeze and the same figure of about 708,000. Specter’s running total of frozen assets at the time was about $6.8 million (including about $1.45 million in PAXG and this roughly 708,000 USDC). That and Bitquery’s $7.3 million ( $5.9 million from Tether + $1.5 million from Paxos) are snapshots from different times—don’t add the two tables together as if they were a new total. Subtracting this roughly 708,000 from Bitquery’s $4.29 million figure leaves about $3.58 million in USDC/EURC still movable. That’s an estimate, not a new figure from any source.

So the freeze ledger now shows all three issuers have acted: Tether, Paxos, and Circle. But let’s be clear about the scale: this roughly 708,000 is only about 1.5% of the $48.5M total; the frozen amount is still under one-fifth, and most of the funds are still in assets like $BTC and $ETH  that nobody can freeze. What hasn’t changed: deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, there’s no resumption schedule, the exchange hasn’t confirmed the total or given a root cause, and BitMart still hasn’t commented on that labeled wallet.

My take: the real lesson here is timestamps—tracking roundups all have cutoff times, and the previous post’s “not frozen” claim was true only at the roundup’s cutoff. Next time you see a conclusion like “X hasn’t acted,” the first thing to check should be its cutoff time, not to take it as the current state.

Risk note: The above is still based on on-chain tracking, not the exchange’s official loss assessment. $BTC  is now around 76729, $ETH  around 2239, and $SOL  around 91.04 (measured against two independent sources at 03:40)—all ordinary fluctuations, so don’t attribute them to this one incident. Fake customer support accounts and fake refund links are most likely to appear while the incident is unfolding; use only the exchange’s official channels.

What do you think: now that all three issuers have acted, will the remaining $3.58 million in USDC/EURC be the next amount frozen, or will it be moved first?

上一帖刚写完就得改一句：Circle 也动手了，上一帖那句“Circle 一分没冻”过期了

这篇是跟进，也是更正，上一帖（02:38）留的口子补上了：上一帖引 Bitquery 盘点写的是“Circle 未冻结、$429 万 USDC/EURC 还能动”，但那个盘点的数据截至 11 月 2 日 15:46 UTC；Circle 的动作发生在之后——美东时间 11 月 2 日 11:19，也就是北京时间 11 月 3 日 00:19，Polygon 链上记录显示 Circle 拉黑了一个钱包，里面约 70.8 万 USDC，那个地址正是交易所自己公布的事件相关目标地址。

两个独立口径对上了：The Defiant 直接写“链上记录证实 Circle 在 Polygon 上冻结了 USDC”；KuCoin 快讯转述研究员 Specter 的说法，同一笔冻结、同一个约 70.8 万的数字。Specter 当时的冻结总账是约 $680 万（含约 $145 万 PAXG 和这约 70.8 万 USDC），和 Bitquery 的 $730 万（Tether $590 万＋Paxos $150 万）是不同时点的快照，别把两张表硬加成一个新总数。按 Bitquery 的 $429 万口径减掉这约 70.8 万算，USDC/EURC 里还剩约 $358 万能动——这是推算，不是哪家的新口径。

所以冻结账本现在是三家都动了：Tether、Paxos、Circle。但分量要说清楚：这约 70.8 万只占 $48.5M 总盘约 1.5%，冻结总数仍不到两成，大头还是 $BTC、$ETH 这类没人能冻的币。没变的东西照旧：充提仍暂停、无恢复时间表、交易所自己没确认总数、没给根因，BitMart 对那个标签钱包也仍没表态。

我的看法：这事真正的教训是时间戳——追踪盘点都有截止时间，上一帖的“未冻结”只在盘点截止那一刻成立。以后再看到“某家没动手”这种结论，第一反应应该是去看它的截止时间，而不是直接当现状。

风险提示：以上仍是链上追踪口径，不是交易所官方定损；$BTC 现约 76729、$ETH 约 2239、$SOL 约 91.04（03:40 双信源实测），都属普通波动，别硬归因到这一个事件上。事件发酵期假客服、假退款链接最容易冒头，只走交易所官方渠道。

你们怎么看：三家发行商都动手了，剩下的 $358 万 USDC/EURC 会是下一笔冻结，还是先被转走？

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in principal and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a 1000U position. If the coin price rises by 1%, your principal gains 10% (relative to your principal); conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss of your principal—note that the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

与近期其他事件关联来看，它印证了监管机构对拥有稳定法币储备的加密机构给予更多关照的趋势。当整个行业都在为生存寻找“数字抵押品”时，Super League 的举动就像是在说：“我们准备用最硬的通货来当底牌”。

Mercado deep dive: $48.5M isn’t the whole story—after the exchange said it had “contained” the incident, the hacker kept sweeping funds for more than two hours

This is a follow-up filling in the gaps left in my previous post (01:38): did the total losses climb any higher, and was there a second batch of freezes? Bitquery’s just-released, transaction-by-transaction on-chain accounting answers both questions—but the added details sting more than the numbers themselves.

First, the numbers. Bitquery counted $48.5M across 10 chains, valued at the price at the time of each transfer. Ethereum alone accounted for $29.5M (188 transactions over 24 minutes), followed by Bitcoin. To be clear about the methodology: that $48.5M includes an EVA token whose one-week trading volume was less than its market cap (about $1.21M). Excluding it brings the total to $47.2M—so compared with the roughly $46.5M in my previous post, the overall figure has only risen slightly. The genuinely new information is in the two points below.

First, the exchange’s claim that it had “迅速控制” (quickly contained the incident) doesn’t line up with the on-chain timeline. Bitquery found that the hacker didn’t just access hot wallets—they could also sign transactions from customers’ deposit addresses. On Ethereum, 35,853 deposit addresses were gradually emptied starting at 12:10 UTC, with the sweep continuing until 15:44 UTC. The exchange issued its “contained” statement at 12:56 UTC—right in the middle of the busiest part of the sweep, which continued for more than two hours afterward. Another 53 deposit addresses were emptied on Bitcoin. Bitquery’s advice is blunt: stop sending funds to old deposit addresses and wait for the exchange to provide new ones.

Second, the freeze tally also checks out. Tether froze $5.9M (USDT, USDT0, USAT, and gold tokens across Polygon, Tron, Ethereum, and Solana), while Paxos froze $1.5M (PAXG and USDP), for a total of $7.3M—about 15% of the overall amount. Circle froze nothing: $4.29M in USDC/EURC remains movable. The remaining roughly 76% consists of assets such as $BTC and $ETH , which their issuers simply can’t freeze. The good news is that most of the funds haven’t moved: the hacker’s 106.07 BTC remain untouched, and the $19.5M transferred to 10 new Ethereum wallets had barely moved by 15:46 UTC. So far, there’s no sign of funds reaching an exchange.

It’s also worth clarifying what hasn’t changed: the exchange still hasn’t confirmed the total, provided a root cause, or given a recovery timeline. Deposits and withdrawals remain suspended (Bitquery’s latest check reflected the situation on Monday afternoon; this search found no official notice that services had resumed). The claim that “the exchange will absorb the losses” is still a statement attributed to it by Bloomberg; it can’t be verified on-chain. Also, Bitquery noted that the same address received about $298,000 from several unrelated wallets 53 minutes before Mercado. One Arbitrum wallet was tagged as BitMart—but BitMart hasn’t commented, and that tag is Bitquery’s own, not evidence that BitMart was hacked.

My take: the key thing to remember from this round isn’t that the figure went from 46.5 to 48.5, but the gap between the words “contained” and the on-chain timeline. A statement can be issued quickly, but containment isn’t complete until control over the signatures for deposit addresses has been regained. The next two things to watch are when the exchange provides new deposit addresses and when it resumes deposits and withdrawals.

Risk reminder: all of the above reflects on-chain tracking, not the exchange’s official loss assessment. $BTC  is currently around 76994, $ETH  around 2252, and $SOL  around 91.92 (cross-checked against two sources at 02:41)—all within ordinary fluctuations. Don’t force a price movement narrative onto this one incident. During a developing incident, fake support accounts and fake refund links are especially likely to appear. Use only the exchange’s official channels, and don’t click “refund” links from unknown sources.

Mercado 深扒来了：$48.5M 还不是全貌，交易所说“已控制”后黑客又扫了两个多小时

这篇是跟进，上一帖（01:38）留的口子补上了：损失总数有没有再往上走、冻结有没有第二批——Bitquery 的链上逐笔盘点刚出来，两个口子都补上了，但补出来的细节比数字本身更扎心。

先说数字。Bitquery 数出来的是 $48.5M，10 条链，作价按每笔转账时价；其中以太坊一链就占了 $29.5M（188 笔、24 分钟），比特币其次。口径要说清楚：这 $48.5M 里含一笔一周成交量都不到它市值的 EVA 代币（约 $121 万），剔掉它就是 $47.2M——所以总数较上一帖的约 $4650 万其实只上调了一点，真正的新料不在总额，在下面这两条。

第一，交易所“已迅速控制”的说法，和链上时间线对不上。Bitquery 发现黑客不只动了热钱包，还能签客户的充值地址：以太坊上 35,853 个充值地址从 12:10 UTC 起陆续被清空，一直持续到 15:44 UTC，而交易所发“已控制”声明是 12:56 UTC——声明发在清扫最忙的当口，清扫又多跑了两个多小时。比特币上另有 53 个充值地址也被清空。Bitquery 的原话很直白：别再往旧充值地址打钱，等交易所给新地址。

第二，冻结的账本也对上了。Tether 冻了 $5.9M（USDT、USDT0、USAT 和黄金代币，横跨 Polygon、Tron、以太坊、Solana），Paxos 冻了 $1.5M（PAXG 和 USDP），合计 $7.3M，约占总数的 15%。但 Circle 一分没冻，$429 万 USDC/EURC 还能动；剩下约 76% 是 $BTC、$ETH 这类发行商根本冻不了的币。好消息是大部分钱还没动：黑客的比特币 106.07 枚原地未动，以太坊转进 10 个新钱包的 $19.5M 到 15:46 UTC 也基本没再动，暂没见进交易所。

没变的东西也要说清楚：交易所自己至今没确认总数、没给根因、没给恢复时间表，充提仍暂停（Bitquery 最后查看为周一下午口径，本轮检索未见官方恢复声明）；“交易所自己承担损失”仍是彭博社转述的表态，链上验不了。还有，Bitquery 提到同一地址在 Mercado 之前 53 分钟还从几个无关联钱包拿了约 $29.8 万，其中一个 Arbitrum 钱包被打上 BitMart 标签——但 BitMart 没表态，这个标签只是 Bitquery 自家的，不能当成 BitMart 被黑的证据。

我的看法：这轮最值得记的不是 46.5 变 48.5，而是“已控制”三个字和链上时间线的落差。声明可以发得很快，但充值地址的签名权没收回来之前，控制就不算完成。接下来就看两点：交易所什么时候给新充值地址、什么时候恢复充提。

风险提示：以上都是链上追踪口径，不是交易所官方定损；$BTC 现约 76994、$ETH 约 2252、$SOL 约 91.92（02:41 双信源实测），都属普通波动，别硬把价格波动归因到这一个事件上。事件发酵期假客服、假退款链接最容易冒头，只走交易所官方渠道，别点来路不明的“退款”链接。

你们怎么看：交易所声明和链上时间线打架，算口径问题，还是控制本身就没到位？

SEC updates crypto asset Q&A | Staking receipt classification depends on structure | ETH falls near 2250; wait and see

My view is to read the regulatory text as defining the boundaries of risk, not to trade it as a bullish catalyst for spot ETH for now. The crypto asset Q&A page on the SEC Division of Corporation Finance website is marked as updated November 2. Its answer on staking receipt tokens explains that, under the circumstances described in the text, if a receipt represents and evidences that its holder owns the underlying digital commodity, and carries no additional economic rights, it may be considered a digital tool with practical utility. If issued by a protocol-based liquid staking provider, it may also qualify as a digital commodity under the conditions described in the text. The key phrases here are “under specific circumstances” and “may.” The page also makes clear that these are the views of SEC staff, not new rules adopted by the Commission; they have no legal force and impose no new obligations. It does not approve every ETH liquid staking product one by one, much less announce that any new ETF has been approved for listing.

Why is this relevant to Ethereum? The ETH staking ecosystem has various types of receipts and wrappers, and legal analysis will consider ownership of the underlying assets, whether the issuer can use assets held in custody, whether the receipt promises additional returns, and whether the protocol depends on centralized management. Describing all staking receipts broadly as “exempt” would obscure differences in product structure. For traders, regulatory interpretations may affect institutional product design and risk discounts, but there are separate steps between a staff Q&A and the registration and listing of specific products, as well as actual fund inflows. It is more useful to watch how providers disclose rights and custody arrangements than to focus on a single headline. Meanwhile, the Ethereum Foundation website still shows that the previously scheduled date for Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed, with a new activation date yet to be set; testnet progress should not be misrepresented as an ETH mainnet upgrade today.

The market reaction remains restrained. At the time of capture, Kraken’s ETH/USD was around $2,250, with a 24-hour high of about $2,314 and low of about $2,242—slightly below the roughly $2,268 I observed last time. This is just a price move and does not prove that the SEC Q&A caused the decline. Farside data show net outflows of about $155.7 million from U.S. ETH funds on October 30; complete figures for November 2 have not yet appeared in the individual columns, and the automatic total of 0.0 should not be taken to mean flows have turned positive. My key levels to watch are support at 2240–2250 and confirmation above at 2280 and 2315. If 2240 breaks decisively and the price still cannot reclaim it on a rebound, cautious waiting should turn into staying away. If the price regains 2315 and subsequent fund data strengthen, only then would I consider increasing exposure. The regulatory text itself cannot confirm price action or fund flows.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase a long position now. I would keep only a conditional spot long on the table, with a position capped at 5% of total capital and no high leverage. The entry trigger would be ETH regaining and holding above 2280, then successfully retesting it, while fund flows show no fresh, significant deterioration. The first target is 2315, where I would take half off; the second target is 2360, with a trailing protective stop on the remainder. The initial stop-loss would be below 2235. If, after entry, the price falls back below 2260 and continues to weaken, or an official regulatory document changes the previous interpretation, I would exit early. If the trigger does not occur within three days, I would cancel the plan. I am willing to wait until the facts, fund flows, and price are all pointing in the same direction before taking limited risk.

SEC更新加密资产问答｜质押凭证分类看结构｜ETH跌近2250先观望

我的态度是把监管文本当作风险边界来读，暂不把它交易成ETH现货利好。美国SEC网站的公司融资部加密资产问答页面标注11月2日更新。其关于质押凭证代币的回答说明：在文中设定的情形下，如果凭证代表并证明持有人拥有底层数字商品，且没有额外经济权利，它可被视为具有实际用途的数字工具；若由基于协议的流动性质押提供者发行，也可能按文中条件归为数字商品。这里的关键词是“在特定情形下”和“可能”。页面同时明确，这些是SEC工作人员观点，不是委员会通过的新规则，没有法律效力，也不新增义务。它没有逐一批准所有ETH流动性质押产品，更没有宣布任何新ETF获准上市。

为什么这对以太坊有参考价值？ETH质押生态有多种凭证与包装形式，法律分析会看底层资产归属、发行人是否可动用托管资产、凭证是否承诺额外收益，以及协议是否依赖中心化管理。把所有质押凭证都笼统称作“已获豁免”，会遮蔽产品结构差异。对交易者而言，监管解释可能影响机构产品设计和风险折价，但从工作人员问答到具体产品注册、上市与实际资金流入，中间还有独立步骤。观察应用方如何披露权利与托管安排，比只看一句标题更有用。与此同时，Ethereum Foundation官网仍显示Glamsterdam在Hoodi测试网的原定日期已推迟，新激活日期未定；不能把测试网进度误写成ETH主网今日升级。

市场反应保持克制。Kraken的ETH/USD截取时约2250美元，近24小时高约2314、低约2242，较我上轮观察的约2268美元再低一些；这只是价格变化，不能证明SEC问答造成下跌。Farside的10月30日美国ETH基金净流出约1.557亿美元，11月2日各栏尚未出现完整数值，自动合计0.0不能当成资金已转正。我的关键观察区是2240至2250的承接，以及2280和2315的上方确认。若2240被有效跌破、反抽仍站不回，谨慎观望应升级为回避；若价格站回2315且后续基金数据转强，才考虑提高参与度。监管文本本身不替价格和资金做确认。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追多，方向仅保留条件式现货试多，仓位最多占总资金5%，不用高杠杆。入场触发是ETH重新站稳2280并回踩不破，同时基金流量未出现新的明显恶化；第一目标2315，到位减半，第二目标2360，余仓上移保护位。初始止损放在2235下方；若入场后重新跌回2260且持续走弱，或正式监管文件改变了此前解释，提前平仓。三天内不触发就取消计划。我愿意等事实、资金和价格排成同一方向，再冒有限的风险。

Why does this news matter?
Tether’s role has always been somewhat ambiguous: it wants to be the dollars in everyone’s wallet while also getting involved in the crypto ecosystem. By directly comparing the company to Asimov’s “Foundation,” the CEO suggested that Tether may be ready to shed some of its “stablecoin guardian” image and pursue more ambitious plans. There are two reasons behind this: First, the crypto industry badly needs reliable infrastructure, such as decentralized exchanges and oracles. Second, regulatory pressure is mounting, and Tether may be trying to create a safer space for itself by presenting as a company that “empowers the entire industry.”

Market impact
This news doesn’t directly move BTC or ETH prices. But think about it: if Tether really can build up its ecosystem, liquidity and use cases across the crypto world could improve, which would benefit all tokens. Have there been similar events in the past? No. But traditional finance offers a point of comparison: when infrastructure like SWIFT gets upgraded, the entire payment system changes along with it. What does this mean? Tether could be worth more in the future than it is today—but only if these plans actually come to fruition.

Trading outlook
This news is more of a sentiment catalyst, as Tether looks to become a “power player behind the scenes.” In the short term, the market may simply digest the news. Looking further ahead, if Tether really does become foundational infrastructure for the ecosystem, the entire sector could benefit. That said, the crypto industry is highly unpredictable. title: Bitmine Buys More Ethereum as Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish
subTitle:
#ETH $ETH Trade with me ETH below
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
$ETH Bitmine Immersion Technologies continued its weekly Ethereum buying streak, purchasing 8,573 ETH worth about $19 million, bringing its total holdings to 6,060,506 ETH (approximately $13.7 billion), or 4.9% of the network's supply. The firm remains the largest Ethereum treasury and second-largest overall crypto treasury, trailing only Strategy. It has bought ETH every week since June 30, 2025, and is 99% of the way to its goal of owning 5% of the supply.
Chairman Tom Lee argued that the market's muted reaction to the record $6.4 billion Binance hack, which the FBI attributed to North Korea, shows crypto's growing resilience. He noted ETH fell just 4% after the breach, compared to an 8% drop and 20% weekly decline following the smaller $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025. Lee cited six reasons for the subdued response, including Binance's full coverage of losses, absence of DeFi failures, industry actions halving the loss, swift FBI attribution, the exploit being a corporate infiltration rather than blockchain flaw, and the limited price downside as evidence of a bull market.
Bitmine's total holdings reached $14.5 billion, including 216 Bitcoin, $498 million in cash and securities, and stakes in other companies. About 86% of its ETH (5.2 million tokens) is staked, generating projected annualized revenue of roughly $358 million.

This reflects a sharp increase in investor interest in artificial intelligence and could force the market to reassess how it values technology companies in the future.

Why does this news matter?
There are two key factors behind this bet. First, Anthropic's approach to generative AI has received recognition from the U.S. government, potentially opening the door to federal contracts. Second, the narrative of Bitcoin as "digital gold" is growing stale, while AI is seen as a new vehicle for "future productivity." If an AI company really can surpass Bitcoin's market cap within a year, it would mean the market is redefining what counts as an "asset worth holding for the long term."

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin could come under pressure from sentiment. Historical data shows that when emerging industries achieve disruptive breakthroughs, traditional "digital gold" assets usually see a temporary pullback. In the long term, however, if AI really does become the next internet, the crypto paradigm could shift from "store of value" to "application ecosystem." This could give platform tokens like Ethereum, which support application ecosystems, a valuation premium. But the precise path of that impact will depend on how quickly capital flows from Bitcoin into AI subsectors.

Strategy
For now, this looks more like a trend signal than a direct price catalyst. If the AI industry can take off over the next year the way Bitcoin once did, all digital asset categories could benefit. In the short term, however, this could widen valuation gaps within digital assets, as some capital may flow out of traditional assets like Bitcoin and into the AI sector.

📰 Why Is Solana Embracing HKDAP While Leaving Its Dollar Stablecoin on Ethereum?

Anchorpoint is exploring the issuance of an offshore Hong Kong dollar stablecoin (HKDAP) on the Solana blockchain, while its US dollar stablecoin (USDP), previously launched on Ethereum, remains in the institutional testing phase. This move signals a subtle shift in Solana’s expansion strategy in Asian markets, particularly in Hong Kong, a major financial center.

Why does this news matter?
Anchorpoint’s decision is no coincidence; there are several deeper reasons behind it. First, one of the main challenges Solana has recently faced is Ethereum’s high fees, which make migration too costly for institutional users. As an important alternative to offshore renminbi, the Hong Kong dollar holds a firm position in Hong Kong’s financial system. The launch of HKDAP could therefore significantly lower the barriers to moving funds between Hong Kong and crypto markets. More importantly, this move may be a test of differences in regulatory environments—Hong Kong’s approach to regulating cryptocurrencies is relatively permissive, while regulatory uncertainty in the Ethereum ecosystem remains high. If HKDAP succeeds, it could become the first Solana stablecoin to receive regulatory approval in Hong Kong, with far-reaching implications for the entire Web3 ecosystem.

Market impact
From a market perspective, this strategy has a dual significance for the Solana ecosystem. On the one hand, it could help bring more traditional financial institutions onto Solana, particularly institutions in Asia, potentially boosting Solana’s activity and liquidity. On the other hand, it could increase competitive pressure on the Ethereum ecosystem, as Ethereum will need to keep improving its fees and addressing regulatory issues to remain competitive. From a broader perspective, the launch of HKDAP may signal a deeper integration of cryptocurrencies and fiat currencies, especially in Asian markets.

Trading approach
💡 This strategy suggests that Solana’s presence in Asian markets may be entering a new phase, but its short-term impact on prices may be limited, as this is only an initial exploration. One thing to watch is whether HKDAP receives formal regulatory approval in Hong Kong; if it does, it could have a more noticeable positive effect on the Solana ecosystem within 3–6 months. Anchorpoint 的这一决策并非偶然，背后有几个深层逻辑。首先，Solana 近期面临的主要挑战之一是以太坊的费用问题，这使得机构用户在迁移时成本过高。港元作为离岸人民币的重要替代品，在香港的金融体系中地位稳固，因此 HKDAP 的推出能显著降低香港与加密市场之间的资金流转门槛。更重要的是，这一举动可能是在测试监管环境的差异——香港对加密货币的监管相对宽松，而以太坊生态的监管不确定性仍然较高。如果 HKDAP 成功，它可能成为第一个获得香港监管认可的 Solana 稳定币，这将对整个 Web3 生态系统产生深远影响。

对市场的影响
从市场角度看，这一策略对 Solana 生态系统具有双重意义。一方面，它有助于推动更多传统金融机构进入 Solana，尤其是亚洲地区的机构，这可能提振 Solana 的活跃度和流动性。另一方面，这也可能引发以太坊生态的竞争压力，因为以太坊需要继续优化其费用和监管问题来保持竞争力。从更宏观的角度看，HKDAP 的推出可能预示着加密货币与法定货币结合的进一步深化，尤其是在亚洲市场。

操作思路
💡 Solana 的这一策略意味着它在亚洲市场的布局可能进入新阶段，但短期内对价格的影响可能有限，因为这只是初步探索。值得关注的点是，如果 HKDAP 能获得香港监管的正式批准，可能会在 3-6 个月内对 Solana 的生态系统产生更明显的积极效应。如果监管环境突然恶化或以太坊出现新的低成本解决方案，这个逻辑可能作废。

【After the Binance hack, what is ETH really being tested on?】

Binance has confirmed that it was hit by a hack and that funds flowed out; the FBI has joined the investigation. According to reports, the hackers have begun swapping the stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin, and Chainalysis says it is handling these conversions. THORChain, meanwhile, has paused swaps involving networks such as Bitcoin and Ethereum due to a block-reorganization vulnerability. The connection between this incident and ETH is about more than just whether “the price will take a hit.” Once on-chain funds pass through exchanges and cross-chain routers, who bears the cost of security?

I prefer to think of ETH as the “settlement layer” of the digital economy, rather than merely an asset to speculate on. When you pay, collateralize, or settle with ETH, you ultimately rely on smart contract rules and network security. But when THORChain pauses, liquidity gets stuck, and users immediately feel the impact: whether the technology works in practice depends not only on peak throughput, but also on whether it can be halted safely when something goes wrong—and whether funds can be recovered.

ETH is currently trading at $2,254.11, down 0.5% over 24 hours and 2.8% over seven days. Support is around $2,205.88, with resistance at $2,355.71. Bitmine continues to buy, while Ethereum spot funds saw record monthly outflows of $1.61 billion—showing that the long-term narrative and short-term fund flows are out of sync. My take is that the market is repricing “security” and “liquidity.”

In practice, exchanges, cross-chain protocols, liquidity providers, and everyday users will all be affected. The business case still holds, but security spending can no longer be treated as just another cost—it must be counted as a basic operating expense for infrastructure. Keep this in mind: when evaluating ETH, don’t just look at whether its price is rising. First ask whether it can settle transactions reliably. Do you think this incident will truly change the industry, or will it soon be forgotten as just another passing episode?

Mercado Bitcoin incident losses rise to about $46.5 million: exchange says it will absorb the losses, while deposits and withdrawals remain disabled

This is a follow-up, filling in the gap left by the previous post (00:38): that post only confirmed that Tether had frozen more than 4.5 million USDT, while the total losses were still based on Hypernative’s preliminary estimate of over $40 million. This update brings a new estimate backed by more data.

Here are the new figures: on-chain tracker Onchain Lens says addresses connected to the incident currently hold about $46.5 million in crypto assets across 46 addresses, including around 3,680 ETH, 106 BTC, and about $8 million in stablecoins. A separate estimate from Arkham analysts puts the figure at about $46 million and rising, saying old deposit addresses are still being swept and meme coins and altcoins are being sold. A note on the figures: trackers differ on the number of addresses (one version says 36, another 46), but their totals are all around $46 million. The exchange itself has yet to confirm the total, so $46.5 million is an on-chain tracking estimate, not an official loss assessment—don’t treat it as a figure announced by the exchange.

There’s also a new statement about who will cover the losses: according to Bloomberg, the exchange said it would absorb the losses itself and expects customers not to be affected. This is consistent with its earlier position that “customers will suffer no losses,” but this time Bloomberg has reported an explicit commitment to cover them. Unfortunately, deposits and withdrawals are still suspended, with no timeline for resuming them. The exchange has still not said which system was affected or whether customer funds were involved.

Compare this with the figures in the previous post and you can see how slow the progress has been: the more than 4.5 million USDT frozen by Tether accounts for less than a tenth of the $46.5 million. And a freeze doesn’t mean the funds have been recovered, let alone that deposits and withdrawals will resume. The funds are still sitting in tracked addresses, and the most immediate problem for users hasn’t changed: they still can’t move their assets.

A quick market update, based on prices checked just before publication: $BTC  was around 77,028 (24h -1.40%), $ETH  around 2,254 (-0.67%), and $SOL  around 92.47 (-2.42%). The spread between Binance spot and OKX perpetuals was under 0.1%. The market hasn’t been sent tumbling by this incident: $BTC  fell from 77,446 at 00:39 to around 77,028, which is ordinary fluctuation—don’t force a connection to this incident. One more point: neither the exchange nor the trackers have linked this Mercado incident to the approximately $6.3 billion theft from Binance on October 29. Don’t assume they were carried out by the same group.

My take: the estimate rising from $40 million to $46.5 million suggests the first tally missed a lot of the sweeping activity, and the losses are broader than initially thought. The exchange saying it will “absorb the losses itself” is a positive statement, but until it provides a timeline, it hasn’t been delivered for users. There’s only one real turning point: deposits and withdrawals resuming.

Risk warning: All figures above come from media reports and on-chain tracking; the exchange has not confirmed the total. A freeze does not mean funds have been recovered. Risks from small exchanges’ hot wallets have been flagged twice already this week. Diversify your assets and don’t keep your entire net worth on one exchange. This is not investment advice.

A quick either-or question: When an exchange has an incident and says, “I’ll absorb the losses myself,” do you believe it—or does it only count once deposits and withdrawals have actually resumed?

content:
Mercado Bitcoin 安全事件账单涨到约 4650 万美元：交易所说损失自己扛，充提还没开

这篇是跟进，上一帖（00:38）留的口子补上了：上一帖只确认了 Tether 冻了超 450 万 USDT，损失总数当时还是 Hypernative 超 4000 万美元的初步统计。这轮有了带量的新口径。

新数字是这样的：链上追踪方 Onchain Lens 称，与事件相关的地址目前在 46 个地址里共持有约 4650 万美元加密资产，包括约 3680 枚 ETH、106 枚 BTC 和约 800 万美元稳定币；另一路 Arkham 分析师口径约 4600 万美元且还在涨，说老充值地址还在被清扫、meme 和山寨币在被卖。先说明口径：各家追踪的地址数有出入（36 个与 46 个两个版本），但总额都落在 4600 万美元一带；交易所自己至今没确认总数，所以 4650 万是链上追踪口径，不是官方定损，别当成交易所亲口报的数。

谁买单这事也有了新表态：据彭博社报道，交易所表示将自行承担这次损失，预计客户不会因此受损。这话和它之前“客户无损失”的口径是一致的，但这次是经彭博社转述的明确兜底表态。可惜的是，充提还是暂停，没有恢复时间表，哪个系统出的事、是不是客户的钱，依然没说。

对照一下上一帖的数字就知道进展有多慢：Tether 冻住的超 450 万 USDT，只占 4650 万的不到一成。而且冻结不等于追回，更不等于充提恢复。钱还在追踪地址里躺着，用户当下最实际的痛点其实没变：里面的资产还是动不了。

行情这边顺带报一下发稿前实测价：$BTC 约 77028（24h -1.40%）、$ETH 约 2254（-0.67%）、$SOL 约 92.47（-2.42%），币安现货对 OKX 永续偏差都在 0.1% 以内。市场没被这事带崩，$BTC 从 00:39 的 77446 回落到 77028 一带，属于普通波动，别硬往这件事上归因。另外再提一句：官方和追踪方至今都没把 Mercado 这事和币安 10 月 29 日约 63 亿美元被盗连起来，别自己脑补成同一伙人。

我的看法：账单从 4000 万涨到 4650 万，说明第一波统计漏了不少清扫动作，损失面比最初想的广；交易所“自己扛”是个积极表态，但没给时间表之前，对用户来说等于还没兑现。真正的转折点只有一个：充提恢复。

风险提示：以上数字均为媒体与链上追踪口径，交易所未确认总数；冻结不等于追回；小所热钱包风险这周已经被连着提醒两次了，资产分散、别把全部身家放一家，不构成投资建议。

二选一问一句：交易所出事后说“损失我自己扛”，你信吗——还是只有充提真正恢复了才算数？

This large-scale accumulation briefly pushed the price to a high of $2,309, but subsequent ETF outflows put it under pressure, and the price failed to break through that resistance level decisively. 以太坊市场深度分析：机构增持与企业买盘难挡ETF流出压力

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月三日凌晨，以太坊报价二千二百七十二美元，过去二十四小时微涨约百分之零点一六。从小时线来看，价格在过去的五个小时内经历了先涨后跌的走势，从二千二百八十七美元附近冲高至二千三百零四美元后回落，最低触及二千二百六十二美元，最终收于二千二百七十美元一线。盘中波动幅度约四十美元，显示出多空双方在这一关键位置的激烈博弈。

以太坊近期曾受到企业大额买盘的提振，Bitmine公司一次性购入八千五百七十三枚以太坊，使其总持仓达到六百零六万枚，约占以太坊总供应量的百分之四点九六。这一大规模增持一度推动价格冲击二千三百零九美元的高位，但随后遭遇ETF资金流出的压力，价格未能有效突破该阻力位。过去一周，以太坊现货ETF累计流出三亿九千六百六十万美元，机构资金的持续撤离抵消了企业买盘的利好效应。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，七日均线报二千二百八十点六美元，二十五日均线报二千二百八十点五美元，九十九日均线报二千二百六十二点四美元。短中期均线几乎粘合，而长期均线在下方提供支撑，表明市场正处于方向选择的关键时刻。指数移动平均线同样呈现收敛态势，七日指数移动平均线降至二千二百七十八美元，与当前价格非常接近。

相对强弱指标方面，六周期RSI降至三十点九五，接近超卖区域但尚未完全进入。十二周期RSI为四十一点九四，二十四周期RSI为四十八点零零，整体处于中性偏弱区域。MACD指标方面，MACD线降至一点四零，信号线为四点五三，柱状图扩大至负三点一三，空头动能在逐步增强。值得注意的是，MACD柱状图已连续多个周期为负值，显示短期下行压力尚未解除。

KDJ指标显示K值二十四点四七、D值三十一点零四、J值十一点三三，J值已深入超卖区域，暗示短期可能存在反弹需求。威廉指标报负八十四点四九，同样处于超卖区域。布林带下轨已降至二千二百六十二美元，价格在下轨附近运行，这种位置通常意味着短期存在均值回归的可能。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪呈现分化格局。一方面，企业层面的大额增持和RWA资产在以太坊上的快速增长为市场提供了基本面支撑。数据显示，以太坊上的代币化股票资产同比增长百分之一百七十，达到八亿二千七百万美元，这一趋势增强了以太坊作为机构级金融基础设施的地位。另一方面，ETF的持续流出和币安黑客事件引发的市场不确定性对短期价格构成压力。

从链上数据来看，欧洲交易时段出现超过八千六百万美元的大额鲸鱼资金流入，一度推动价格突破九十九周期指数移动平均线，但随后动能未能持续。执法部门请求冻结数百个与交易所黑客资金洗钱相关的地址，这一消息也加剧了市场的谨慎情绪。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临技术面的超卖修复需求，中期则需要在二千三百美元附近确认突破才能打开上行空间。建议投资者关注二千二百六十二美元的布林带下轨支撑，以及二千三百零九美元的前高阻力位。

📰 Binance just proved its reserves. Now it’s made up 95% of the losses from a hack—what does that actually mean?

Binance just rolled out zero-knowledge proofs so users can verify its reserves, and now it’s backed that up with real money: it has replenished 95% of the assets lost in a hacking incident. Users holding major coins like Bitcoin, Ether, and BNB can now verify that they’re backed 1:1. Reported by The Block.

Why does this news matter?
This time, Binance isn’t just making promises—it’s putting real money toward filling the hole. Why is that important? First, the hack shook the industry’s trust, and Binance is now showing through its actions that it can recover. Second, this is happening as industry regulation ramps up, demonstrating that major players can help themselves—and perhaps giving regulators a little more confidence to ease up. Finally, compared with last week’s post saying “proof of reserves didn’t get the market excited,” this marks a shift from words to action: Binance hasn’t just talked about it; it has actually filled 95% of the hole. That contrast speaks volumes.

Impact on the market
The direct impact on BTC and ETH may be more about restoring confidence. Previously, proof of reserves merely helped smooth over trust concerns. Now that the assets have actually been replenished, it’s like sending the market a signal of certainty. But could it change the broader trend? Honestly, BTC and ETH are already so strong that this bit of good news feels more like a stepping stone at elevated levels than something likely to trigger a rally. Historically, in a market like 2017, panic buying only came when the entire industry’s chain of operations was breaking down.

Trading strategy
💡 Binance replenishing 95% of the assets matters more for ETH than BTC, because ETH relies more on this kind of trust anchor. But this is mainly a confidence-recovery rally, not a signal that every dip is a buying opportunity. If ETH starts seeing profit-taking as it rebounds toward around $2400, that would show the recovery is genuinely limited.

币安刚搞完零知识证明让用户能验钞，结果真金白银地回来了：黑客事件损失的95%资产它补齐了，现在比特币、以太、BNB这些主流币用户都能验到是1:1实物的。The Block报道。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次不是币安说说而已，是真金白银地填坑。为什么重要？首先，黑客攻击把行业信任炸了，现在币安用实际行动说"我能恢复"。其次，这发生在行业监管抬头期，证明巨头有能力自救，可能给监管松绑一点点底气。最后，对比上周"证明储备没让市场嗨"的帖子，这回是量变到质变——不是嘴上说说，是实实在在把95%的坑填了，这种反差更能说明问题。

对BTC和ETH的直接影响可能更多是情绪修复。之前证明储备只是给信任擦油，现在真金白银回来，相当于给市场发了个确定性信号。但要说能改变大趋势？说实话，现在的BTC和ETH已经太强了，这点利好更像是在高位给个台阶下，不容易引爆上涨。参考历史，2017年那种行情，得是整个行业链断裂才有的恐慌性买入。

操作思路
💡 这次币安补足95%资产对ETH来说比BTC更有意义，因为ETH更依赖这种信任锚。但这波更多是情绪修复行情，不是说跌了就能抄底。如果ETH反弹到$2400附近开始获利了结，这个修复的力度就真的有限了。

Mercado incident follow-up: Tether freezes over 4.5 million USDT, confirming the question mark from the previous post

This is a follow-up, not a rehash of the previous post. In the previous post (November 2, 23:38), I deliberately left some room for doubt: at the time, the Tether freeze was only a single-source rumor involving about $3.7 million, with no confirmation from the exchange or Tether, so it shouldn’t be treated as conclusive. That uncertainty has now been cleared up—Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino personally confirmed that over 4.5 million USDT related to the Mercado Bitcoin security incident has been frozen. CoinDesk published the news at 23:53 Beijing time, and Bitcoin Magazine reported the same, both citing Ardoino himself—not secondhand rumors.

First, let’s separate facts from opinions. The facts: Mercado Bitcoin is still suspending deposits and withdrawals; the company has yet to disclose total losses, identify the affected system, or provide a recovery timeline. Hypernative’s preliminary estimate of over $40 million remains a third-party estimate; the exchange has yet to confirm that figure. The 4.5 million figure is only somewhat higher than the rumor in the previous post, and “over 4.5 million” is a lower-bound figure, not an exact total. Roughly comparing it with the preliminary estimate of over $40 million, the frozen funds amount to only a little over 10%. The bulk—including the approximately 2,852 $ETH, 106 $BTC, and 10,700 $SOL , etc., previously tracked—are still in addresses associated with the attacker, according to the previous post, and there’s no word that they’ve been returned.

My take is simple: the issuer’s ability to block funds is genuinely effective, but a freeze doesn’t mean the funds have been recovered, much less that the incident is over. In the Binance case involving $6.3 billion, stablecoin issuers froze about $3 billion within 70 minutes—that was a matter of scale. In Mercado’s case, 4.5 million is just the opening move. What matters is whether there will be another round of freezes, and whether the frozen coins can ultimately be returned to the exchange. Every day deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, the assets of over 4.8 million users in Brazil (the background figure from the previous post) remain inaccessible. That’s what ordinary users should be watching most closely.

Prices at the time of publication (live checks against two sources at 00:39 Beijing time, November 3; Binance spot / OKX perpetual prices differed by ≤0.06%): $BTC  was about $77,446, down 0.78% over 24 hours; $ETH  was about $2,270, up 0.10% over 24 hours; $SOL  was about $93.47, down 1.28% over 24 hours. The broader market barely reacted to this follow-up. Don’t take it as a reason to buy the dip.

Risk disclaimer: This is an incident follow-up, not investment advice. The freeze figure, total losses, and recovery timeline are all still subject to change. Treat any claims that funds have been “recovered” or that operations have “resumed” with skepticism until they’re confirmed.

What do you think? With exchanges having one incident after another this week, would you move large assets to a cold wallet first, or do you think the protection offered by a major exchange is enough?

Mercado 事件跟进：Tether 冻了超 450 万 USDT，上一帖的悬念坐实了

这篇是跟进，不是重复发上一帖。上一帖（11 月 2 日 23:38）里我特意留了个口子：Tether 冻结当时只是单源传闻，约 370 万美元，没获交易所或 Tether 确认，别当定论。现在这个口子补上了——Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino 本人出面确认，已冻结与 Mercado Bitcoin 安全事件相关的超 450 万枚 USDT。CoinDesk 北京时间 23:53 刊发、Bitcoin Magazine 同口径报道，都是引 Ardoino 本人的表态，不是二手传闻。

先把事实和看法分开。事实部分：Mercado Bitcoin 仍是充提暂停状态，官方仍没给损失总数、没说受影响的是哪个系统、没给恢复时间表；Hypernative 超 4000 万美元的初步统计仍是第三方估计，交易所至今没确认这个数；450 万这个数，只比上一帖的传闻高了一截，而且是“超 450 万”的下限口径，不是精确总额。按超 4000 万的初步估计粗算，冻住的这部分也就一成出头，大头——之前追踪到的约 2852 枚 $ETH、106 枚 $BTC、10700 枚 $SOL 等——按上一帖的口径仍在攻击者相关地址里，没听说已归还。

我的看法就一句：发行商这条拦截通道是真管用，但冻结不等于追回，更不等于事件翻篇。币安那单 63 亿美元里，稳定币发行商 70 分钟内就冻了约 30 亿美元，那是规模效应；Mercado 这单里，450 万只是开局，关键要看接下来有没有第二批冻结、以及被冻的币最终能不能回到交易所手里。充提一天不恢复，巴西那 480 多万用户（上一帖背景数）的币就一天动不了，这个才是普通用户最该盯的。

发稿前现价（北京时间 11 月 3 日 00:39 双信源实测，币安现货／OKX 永续偏差均 ≤0.06%）：$BTC 约 77446 美元，24h 跌 0.78%；$ETH 约 2270 美元，24h 涨 0.10%；$SOL 约 93.47 美元，24h 跌 1.28%。大盘没因为这条跟进消息起什么波澜，别拿它当抄底理由。

风险提示：这只是事件跟进帖，不是投资建议；冻结数字、损失总数、恢复时间都还在变，任何“已追回”“已恢复”的说法出现前都先打个问号。

你们怎么看？交易所这周连着出事，你是先把大额资产挪冷钱包，还是觉得大所兜底就够了？

📰 Is AI really smarter than scientists? What exactly is Altman’s statement going to change?

OpenAI boss Sam Altman recently made a bold claim: AI is now much smarter than many top scientists. Behind this statement is the growing capability of AI, which could upend white-collar work—but humanity needs to quickly learn how to manage it. The news set both the tech and crypto worlds abuzz. After all, AI is one of crypto’s major trends, and smarter AI could mean the crypto market is about to go on a steroid-fueled run.

Why does this news matter?
Altman didn’t pull this claim out of thin air. Over the past few quarters, AI has been on a tear, becoming increasingly capable at everything from writing papers to conducting research. For example, AI can independently propose new drug molecules, solve complex mathematical problems, and even help scientists design experiments. This means AI could eventually take over many jobs that once required human brainpower. What does this mean for cryptocurrency? It means the story of AI as a sector isn’t over—and there’s more and more room for imagination. Put simply: the stronger AI gets, the greater the opportunities in crypto could be.

Impact on the market
What direct impact does this have on BTC and ETH? On the surface, AI’s rapid progress could lead more people to see cryptocurrency—especially tokens with AI applications—as the way of the future. For example, if ETH’s Layer 2 networks integrate better with AI, their value could be redefined. But at a deeper level, AI’s rise could make regulators more nervous—after all, AI is so capable, and nobody knows what trouble it might cause. It’s a bit like Bitcoin back in the day: technological breakthroughs also brought regulatory pressure. Have there been similar events in the past? The 2018 AI stock bubble is a cautionary tale, so don’t focus only on the apparent positives.

How to approach it
The stronger AI gets, the more likely it is to push cryptocurrencies—especially foundational technologies like ETH—higher, but the market may remain volatile in the short term. If AI’s development truly exceeds expectations—for instance, if an AI system suddenly becomes capable of operating completely autonomously—BTC and ETH could see a new breakout. But if regulations suddenly tighten, or AI is instead used for malicious purposes, such as large-scale cyberattacks, this thesis could immediately fall apart.

📰 AI真强过科学家？Altman这番话到底要改写什么？

OpenAI老板Sam Altman最近放了个大炮：AI现在比很多顶尖科学家聪明多了。这话背后是AI越来越能干，可能要颠覆白领工作，但人类得赶紧学会怎么管它。这消息一出，科技圈和加密圈都炸锅了——毕竟AI可是加密货币大趋势之一，聪明点儿可能意味着币市要跟吃了兴奋剂似的。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Altman这话不是拍脑袋的。AI最近几个季度像打了鸡血似的，从写论文到做科研，能耐越来越大。比如AI能独立提出新药物分子、解决复杂的数学问题，甚至帮科学家做实验设计。这意味着以前很多需要人类脑力活儿的岗位，未来可能要被AI抢了。这对加密货币意味着什么？意味着AI这个赛道的故事还没讲完，而且越来越有想象空间。简单说：AI越强，加密圈的机会可能越大。

对市场的影响
这对BTC和ETH有什么直接关系呢？表面上看，AI越来越牛，可能让更多人觉得加密货币（尤其是能搞AI的代币）是未来的大方向。比如ETH的Layer2网络如果和AI结合得更好，价值可能被重新定义。但更深层次的是，AI的崛起可能让监管机构更紧张——毕竟AI太能干了，不知道会不会出什么幺蛾子。这就像比特币当年一样，技术突破的同时也带来了监管压力。历史上有类似事件吗？2018年AI概念股泡沫破裂就是前车之鉴，所以不能光看表面利好。

操作思路
AI越强越可能推动加密货币（尤其是ETH这类底层技术）往上走，但短期内市场可能还会震荡。如果AI发展真的超预期，比如某个AI系统突然能完全自主运行，那BTC和ETH可能会迎来新爆发点。但如果监管突然收紧，或者AI反而被用来搞破坏（比如大规模网络攻击），这个逻辑就立马作废。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean to Fuel a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer tokens and to mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people rush to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the unit price of Gas).

【Why it’s related to the coin price】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people have never wondered why it’s worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is operated by its issuer: you give it $1, and it issues you 1 USDT, while placing
dollars (and equivalent assets) in reserve. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can apply to the issuer
for redemption. This “issuance-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to $0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly trade to bring it back in line.

ETH at about $2,289 | FATF launches targeted review of virtual assets | Regulatory expectations precede results

My stance is cautious and mostly wait-and-see. Binance Square’s trending topics included “FATF launches anti-money laundering review of crypto hubs.” I checked the Financial Action Task Force’s dedicated announcement on October 30 and the outcomes of its plenary meeting around the same time: it decided to launch targeted reviews of jurisdictions that are significant for virtual asset activity and have gaps in implementation, and to accelerate subsequent follow-up. Initial findings are planned for June 2027, with further findings planned for October 2027. The review concerns how jurisdictions implement anti-money laundering standards for virtual assets and service providers; it is not an announcement today of new restrictions on the ETH protocol itself, nor does it mean a particular exchange has already been penalized. Calling a “review launch” “regulation already in force” would misjudge the timeline.

Why pay attention to ETH? Ethereum supports substantial stablecoin settlement, trading platform interfaces, and decentralized finance applications, while cross-border fund flows still often connect to regulated service providers. If major jurisdictions move faster to close regulatory gaps, compliance costs for custody, identity verification, deposits and withdrawals, and market making could change; the pathways for on-chain activity and institutional access could also be reassessed. The impact is not one-sided: clear rules could improve institutional access, while overly rapid enforcement could increase short-term friction. The FATF announcement sets out a review process and future disclosure dates; it does not allow us to conclude that ETH funds will necessarily flow out today. The crypto asset custody rules proposed by the U.S. SEC last week are still open for public comment, and should not be added to the narrative as if they were “fully in effect.”

So far, the market has not shown a clearly confirmed one-way reaction to this announcement. At the time of observation, ETH was around $2,288.9, up about 0.86% from the previous close, with an intraday range of roughly $2,251.6 to $2,309.5. Progress on recovery from exchange security incidents, ETF flows, and the Federal Reserve’s decision to maintain its interest rate range at 3.75% to 4% are also affecting risk appetite. Around $2,250 is short-term support, while $2,310 is the intraday ceiling; if ETH breaks above $2,310 and quickly falls back, I would not treat that as confirmation of a trend. If subsequent FATF documents change the scope of the review, or specific jurisdictions issue implementation details that differ from current expectations, I’ll reassess rather than mechanically sticking to this view.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now; I’d only consider a small long position if certain conditions are met. I’d use 2% of total capital to test the position only if ETH holds above $2,310 for at least two hours and there are no new negative official disclosures on security or regulation. I’d first target $2,350, taking half off there, and look to $2,400 with the remainder; if ETH falls back below $2,260 after entry, I’d stop out and close the entire position. If actual disclosures change the underlying rationale, I’d exit early; if the conditions aren’t met, I’d stay out of the market and wouldn’t present a pending plan as a profit. There is still time between a regulatory review and its results, so position sizing should not get ahead of the evidence.

Sources: FATF’s October 30 announcement on targeted reviews and plenary outcomes, the U.S. SEC custody rule proposal, and the Federal Reserve’s October 28 statement. #FATF启动加密中心反洗钱审查 #ETH

This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH约2289美元｜FATF启动虚拟资产定向审查｜监管预期先于结果

我的态度是谨慎偏观望。币安广场热榜出现“FATF启动加密中心反洗钱审查”，我核对了金融行动特别工作组10月30日的专门公告和同期全会成果：它决定对虚拟资产活动重要、现有落实情况有缺口的司法辖区启动定向审查，并加快后续跟进；首批结果计划在2027年6月公布，进一步结果计划在2027年10月公布。这里的对象是司法辖区落实虚拟资产与服务商反洗钱标准的情况，并非今天宣布对ETH协议本身实施新禁令，也不是某个交易所已经被处罚。把“启动审查”说成“监管已经落地”会错估时间表。

ETH为什么需要关注？以太坊承载大量稳定币结算、交易平台接口和去中心化金融应用，跨境资金进出最终仍常与受监管的服务商相连。若重要地区加快补齐规则，托管、身份核验、出入金与做市的合规成本可能变化，链上活动和机构接入的路径也可能被重估。影响方向不单一：明确规则可能改善机构可进入性，执行过急也可能抬高短期摩擦。FATF公告给的是审查过程和未来披露节点，无法推导今天ETH资金一定流出。上周美国SEC提出的加密资产托管规则仍是征求意见中的提案，也不能拿来叠加成“全面生效”的叙事。

市场目前并未围绕这一公告走出可确认的单边反应。观察时ETH约2288.9美元，较前收盘涨约0.86%，日内约2251.6至2309.5美元。交易所安全事件的恢复进度、ETF资金以及美联储维持3.75%至4%的利率区间，同样影响风险偏好。2250美元附近是短线防线，2310美元是日内上沿；若突破2310又迅速跌回，暂不把它当趋势确认。若FATF后续文件改变审查范围，或有具体地区出台与现在预期不同的执行细则，我会重新评估，而不是机械沿用这篇判断。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只预设条件式轻仓做多。只有ETH站稳2310美元至少两小时，并且没有新的官方安全或监管负面披露，才用总资金2%试仓。目标先看2350美元，触及减半，剩余看2400美元；入场后跌回2260美元下方止损并全部平仓。若实际披露改变逻辑，则提前平仓；条件不触发就空仓，不把待执行计划写成盈利。监管从审查到结果还有时间，仓位不应抢在证据前面。

来源：FATF10月30日定向审查公告及全会成果、美国SEC托管规则提案、美联储10月28日声明。#FATF启动加密中心反洗钱审查 #ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Brazil’s largest exchange hit by an incident: over $40 million in suspicious outflows, deposits and withdrawals halted | November 2

First, let’s get the timeline straight: this is a follow-up post. The exchange’s official statement came out at 20:56 Beijing time today; detailed verification by major English-language media didn’t appear until 23:32. I missed a couple of earlier rounds, so I’m not pretending this is breaking news from 11 p.m.

Here are the facts: Brazil’s largest exchange, Mercado Bitcoin, confirmed today that a security incident involving one of its systems had occurred and was quickly contained. Deposits and withdrawals have been suspended—it’s a precautionary suspension, not a sign that they’ve resumed. The official statement said just three things: customers suffered no losses, no data was leaked, and the exchange is tracking the assets and cooperating with the relevant authorities. Note that it didn’t call this a hack, give a loss figure, say when services would resume, or say whose funds were moved.

Separately, preliminary figures from on-chain security firm Hypernative—which the exchange has not confirmed—put suspicious outflows at over $40 million across at least 10 chains. The suspected attacker’s addresses currently hold around 2,852 $ETH, 106 $BTC, 10,700 $SOL, 6.7 million XLM, and more than 200 other tokens. Most of the funds were moved during a 34-minute window between 14:19 and 14:53 Beijing time today, but sweeping of Bitcoin deposit addresses began as early as 10:15 a.m. The exchange later also published a list of related addresses, solely for tracking purposes.

There’s also one single-source claim, so let’s flag it upfront: Brazilian media say Tether froze around $3.7 million in related funds. This has only been reported by that one outlet, and I haven’t found confirmation from either the exchange or Tether. Don’t treat it as settled fact.

My take: Binance had a $6.3 billion incident just four days ago, and now Brazil’s biggest exchange has halted deposits and withdrawals. Even though neither the exchange nor Hypernative has linked the two incidents, the theme of this week has changed: it’s not just one exchange having bad luck—exchange security is coming under intense scrutiny across the board. The price itself hasn’t collapsed on this news: $BTC  was around $77,813 before publication, down 0.37% over 24 hours. That suggests the market is treating this as an isolated incident for now, rather than as a source of systemic panic.

A risk warning upfront: if you have funds on Mercado Bitcoin, wait for a resumption announcement through official channels only. Don’t click any links claiming to offer “withdrawal resumption” or “compensation claims”—fake links spread fastest at times like this. And if you don’t use that exchange, don’t just watch from the sidelines: exchange incidents don’t always give you advance notice.

Which side are you on? A: This is a week of exchange-security blowups. B: It’s an isolated incident in the wake of Binance, blown out of proportion?

一、以太坊市场分析：震荡中寻找方向，基本面改善与资金流出并存

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月二日晚间，以太坊报价二千二百八十九点九二美元，二十四小时内上涨百分之一点零四。价格在二千二百七十六至二千三百零五美元区间内波动，整体呈现小幅反弹后回落的态势。从小时级别K线来看，最近五根蜡烛线呈现涨跌交替的格局，价格在二千二百九十美元附近反复拉锯，短期方向尚不明朗。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，七日均线约二千二百八十八美元，略低于当前价格，二十五日均线约二千二百八十一美元，九十九日均线约二千二百六十四美元。短中期均线呈现多头排列，价格运行在主要均线上方，这是相对积极的信号。然而，价格与七日均线非常接近，说明短期支撑力度有限，需要观察能否有效站稳。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线约五点二六，DEA线约六点二零，MACD柱状图为负零点九四，虽然DIFF线仍在零轴上方，但已下穿DEA线形成死叉，且绿柱有扩大趋势，表明短期动能正在减弱。RSI六周期读数四十八点零六，处于中性区域，既未超买也未超卖，说明当前价格处于相对均衡状态。RSI十二周期和二十四周期分别在五十三点一五和五十四点三十五，同样位于中性区域。

布林带显示上轨约二千三百零九美元，中轨约二千二百八十五美元，下轨约二千二百六十一美元。价格在中轨和上轨之间运行，带宽适中，表明波动率处于正常水平。KDJ指标中K值三十八点五八，D值三十九点零九，J值三十七点五五，三线在中低位区域粘合，尚未形成明确的方向性信号。

威廉指标读数负七十五点六六，已接近超卖区域，暗示短期可能存在一定的技术性反弹需求。随机RSI指标读数七点六二，已深入超卖区域，这是一个值得关注的信号，可能预示着短期反弹机会。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场环境与比特币有相似之处，但也有其独特的基本面因素。从资金面来看，以太坊现货ETF在过去一周净流出三亿九千六百六十万美元，十月份累计流出超过十六亿美元，BlackRock的ETHA基金领跌。这反映出机构投资者在短期内对以太坊持谨慎态度。

然而，从基本面来看，以太坊生态正在经历显著的改善和增长。机构实体在近期增持了八千五百七十三枚以太坊，总持仓达到六百零六万枚以太坊，约占流通供应量的百分之四点九。这种大规模的机构增持为以太坊提供了坚实的基本面支撑。

现实世界资产代币化在以太坊网络上取得了显著进展，代币化股票同比增长百分之一百七十，达到八亿两千七百万美元的规模。这一趋势不仅增加了以太坊网络的使用需求，也为以太坊的长期价值提供了新的支撑逻辑。随着更多传统金融资产上链，以太坊作为主要的智能合约平台将持续受益。

币安事件对以太坊的影响同样不容忽视。作为被盗资产中的重要组成部分，以太坊的流动性和价格在一定程度上受到了冲击。但随着币安恢复百分之九十五的资产并逐步开放各类提款渠道，市场信心正在逐步修复。法币提款渠道的恢复，包括美元、欧元、日元等主要货币，标志着币安运营正在回归正常化。

从更宏观的角度来看，美国中期选举的结果可能对加密监管框架产生深远影响。加密行业已投入超过一亿七千万美元进行政治游说，预测市场显示民主党有约百分之七十的概率重新控制国会。如果国会控制权发生变化，可能会加速或推迟正在审议中的加密监管法案，这对以太坊乃至整个加密市场都将产生重要影响。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临ETF资金流出和技术指标偏弱的压力，但机构持续增持、RWA生态增长和基本面改善为价格提供了支撑。投资者应关注二千二百六十至二千二百七十六美元的关键支撑区域，以及二千三百零九美元附近的布林带上轨阻力。在方向明确之前，建议保持谨慎，等待更明确的信号再做决策。

Stories from the Crypto Boom: From Bitcoin to an Educational Venture

According to Erik Finman’s biography published by TEDxTeen, he invested $1,000 he received from his grandmother in Bitcoin, then sold his holdings for $100,000.

He used the proceeds to launch Botangle from his home in Idaho, a venture connecting students with teachers online. Entrepreneur covered his story on June 11, 2014, when he was 15 years old.

The important distinction: the amount cited is the sale proceeds, not a documented net profit after costs and taxes, nor an estimate of his wealth today. And starting a venture does not prove that it went on to succeed financially.

A practical lesson: set a realistic financial goal and make a plan for using any gains if they materialize, rather than letting excitement make the decision for you. Funding a skill or a venture requires independent research, even if the money comes from a successful trade.

This is a published account, not audited financial records. Early entry, timing, and luck are influential factors; success stories do not represent everyone’s odds of succeeding.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest beginner misconception: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings grind away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat,
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and stay flat after a string of losses—the money you save at these three moments,
is more than most traders make from their trades.

We’ve all heard the hunting metaphor, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. Keep your capital intact, and you’ll have bullets when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your bullets.

【ETH spot funds post record outflows, while security incidents put on-chain trading in the spotlight】

First, let’s get the Binance situation straight. The FBI has confirmed North Korea’s involvement in the $6 billion Binance hack and has asked the DeFi community to block the related BTC, ETH, and SOL addresses. Chainalysis reportedly said the attackers have already used thousands of addresses, and that number may continue to grow. What hasn’t been confirmed is where the funds ultimately went—don’t mistake tracking for recovery.

This is about more than just another headline for ETH. The FBI’s request to block addresses, combined with THORChain pausing swaps involving networks such as Bitcoin and Ethereum because of a block-reorganization vulnerability, directly affects users who rely on cross-chain liquidity, market makers, and node operators. The business logic checks out too: security incidents trigger law-enforcement cooperation, DeFi’s composability lets funds move along their paths more quickly, but on-chain tracking also makes addresses more visible.

The market side is even more striking: ETH spot funds saw $1.61 billion in outflows in a single month, a record. ETH is currently around $2,285, still down 1.6% over seven days. I wouldn’t interpret this as “the bottom is in.” The playbook for shaking people out may have changed since 2017, but the core is the same: sentiment around money turns sour first, then people look for the exit.

Remember this: an on-chain address being traceable doesn’t mean the assets will be frozen immediately; ETF outflows are a fund-flow behavior, not a verdict on ETH’s fundamentals.

What matters more to you right now: the security incident or this wave of outflows from ETH? Getting itchy trigger fingers?

先把币安这件事说清楚。FBI已确认朝鲜方面参与规模达60亿美元的币安黑客事件，并要求DeFi社区封锁相关BTC、ETH、SOL地址；Chainalysis据报道表示，攻击者已使用数千个地址，后续数量可能继续增加。还没确认的是资金最终去向，别把追踪当成追回。

这事和ETH的关系，不是一条新闻那么简单。FBI请求封锁地址，THORChain又因区块重组漏洞暂停了涉及比特币、以太坊等网络的兑换，直接受影响的是依赖跨链流动性的用户、做市者和节点经营者。商业逻辑也通：安全事件触发执法协作，DeFi的组合性让资金路径更快扩散，但链上追踪也让地址暴露得更明显。

市场端更扎眼：ETH现货基金单月流出16.1亿美元，创下纪录；ETH现报约2285美元，7日仍跌1.6%。我不把这解读成“跌透了”。2017年那套割法，包装换了，核心还是资金情绪先坏、后找出口。

记住这一点：链上地址能被追踪，不等于资产立刻冻结；ETF流出是资金行为，不等于ETH基本面被宣判。

你们现在更在意安全事件，还是ETH这波资金流出？手痒不痒？

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% of their time reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (what your reasoning was), what went wrong or right (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover: your losses
Your trade log has a lot of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or always closing winning trades too soon.

Market conditions change, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

Study Notes | Upgradeable Contracts
① Common proxy patterns include transparent proxies and UUPS (EIP-1822). The main difference is whether the upgrade functionality is written in the proxy contract or the logic contract.
② EIP-1967 specifies standard storage locations in proxy contracts for the logic contract address and admin address, making proxy contracts easier for block explorers and wallets to identify.
③ Before depositing funds, check on a block explorer whether the contract is a proxy, which address has upgrade privileges, and whether there is a timelock.

The fifth ZK snapshot for Proof of Reserves is now open for independent verification. ETH is currently at 2287.44, up 0.76% over 24 hours. But at the same time, the 8h funding rate is just +0.0041%, compared with Binance perpetuals’ 0.0100% benchmark—about 41% of the full rate. Verifiability has now reached the point where users can run the checks themselves, yet leveraged traders aren’t paying a penny more in funding for it. Taken together, these two facts tell us more than that small green candle alone.

First, what exactly has the ZK snapshot changed? Proof of Reserves addresses the tail risk of exchange credit risk: users can independently verify asset coverage at a given moment, turning the question “Are my coins there?” from a matter of trust into a matter of computation. But note that this reduces the discount; it doesn’t create buying demand. The incentive for panic withdrawals is weakened, and users are more willing to leave ETH on exchanges. That’s an improvement in the composition of holdings, but it won’t conjure up a new group of spot buyers. Look at the security incident recovery announcement alongside CZ’s thanks to law enforcement for freezing funds, and the overall narrative is one of “restored trust”—raising the floor, not the ceiling. News like this typically lowers volatility rather than kick-starting a trend.

The second data point is more worth watching: +0.0041% annualizes to about 4.5%. The price is rising, so longs have to pay, but they’re extremely reluctant to do so. Compare that with the 70.3% share of accounts that are long: plenty of people, but leverage is cheap. These two figures need to be understood separately: the account share measures “how many accounts hold longs,” while the funding rate measures “how much those longs are willing to pay for leverage.” 70.3% shows retail traders are heavily aligned in one direction; 0.0041% shows they have no desire to increase leverage and feel no urgency to squeeze shorts. In a rally truly driven by leverage, funding rates rise ahead of prices. Right now, price is moving first while funding stays flat. Longs are riding spot’s coattails, not stepping on the gas themselves.

The third dimension is open interest. Open interest is 5.393 billion USDT, and 24-hour trading volume is 5.576 billion USDT, putting intraday turnover at about 1.03x. That ratio is on the low side, meaning today’s green candle wasn’t built on newly posted margin; existing positions are simply shifting around. Without fresh capital coming in, price sustainability depends on steady buying in the spot market. Once spot buying stops, shorts on the derivatives side face no holding-cost pressure because funding is so low, so they won’t be in a hurry to close. If neither side moves, the price can easily give back its gains.

The risk lies in the 70.3% figure itself. It’s not a directional indicator; it’s a crowding indicator. The more concentrated long accounts are, the more their stop-loss levels overlap. If a key level breaks, selling will come from the same stops in the same group of accounts—not from new bearish money. The flip side of low funding is that longs haven’t paid much to hold their positions, so they may have less tolerance for unrealized losses and run faster. Proof of Reserves makes “exchange risk” quantifiable, but quantifiable risk isn’t the same as no risk; it just moves uncertainty out of the black box and into the open.

My own assessment is that the current setup is “lower pricing of tail risk + a lack of leverage fuel for upside.” The former supports the price from falling too far; the latter limits how quickly it can rise. To confirm the direction, I’m not looking for a new price high. I’m watching to see whether the 8h funding rate can climb back above the 0.0100% benchmark. Only when funding gets above that level will it show that longs are willing to pay full price to hold their positions—that’s when leverage is coming in. Until then, the rally is a spot-market story, unrelated to derivatives. The time to be truly cautious isn’t when funding spikes to a high level, but when everyone thinks, “It’s been verified—it’s safe.”

content:
储备金证明的第5期 ZK 快照开放独立验证了，ETH 现价 2287.44，24 小时 +0.76%。但同一时间，8h 资金费率只报 +0.0041%，币安永续的基准是 0.0100%，也就是满额的 41% 左右。可验证性这件事已经落地到用户自己能跑一遍的程度，杠杆端却没有为此多付一分钱租金。这两个事实放在一起，比单看那根小阳线有信息量。

先说 ZK 快照到底改变了什么。储备证明压的是交易所信用风险的尾部——用户能独立验证某一时刻的资产覆盖，意味着“我的币在不在”这个问题从信任变成了计算。但要注意它压的是折价，不是制造买盘。恐慌性提币的动机被削弱，ETH 留在交易所的意愿上升，这是持有结构的改善；它不会凭空变出一批新的现货买家。把安全事件恢复公告和 CZ 感谢执法机构冻结资金那条一起看，整个叙事线是“信任修复”，修复的是下限，不是上限。这类消息通常带来的是波动率下移，而不是趋势启动。

第二个数据更值得盯：+0.0041% 折年约 4.5%。价格是涨的，多头是要付钱的，但付得极不情愿。对照多头账户占比 70.3%——人多，钱不贵。这两件事必须拆开理解：账户占比统计的是“有多少个账户持有多头”，费率统计的是“这些多头愿意为杠杆付多少”。70.3% 说明散户方向高度一致，0.0041% 说明这批人没有加大杠杆的意愿，也没有被逼空的紧迫感。真正的杠杆推动行情，费率会先于价格走高；现在是价格先动、费率不动，多头是搭现货的车，不是自己踩油门。

第三个维度看存量。持仓量 53.93 亿 USDT，24 小时成交额 55.76 亿 USDT，日内换手大约 1.03 倍。这个比例偏低，意味着今天这根阳线不是靠新增保证金堆出来的，是既有仓位在里面挪。没有增量资金进场的情况下，价格的持续性依赖现货端的连续性买盘，而现货买盘一旦停下，合约端因为费率太低，空头没有持仓成本压力，也不会急着平——两边都不动，价格就容易还回去。

风险点就在 70.3% 这个数字本身。它不是方向指标，是拥挤度指标。多头账户越集中，止损位越重叠，一旦跌破关键位置，卖出来自于同一批账户的同一批止损，而不是来自新的看空资金。低费率的另一面是：多头没有为持仓付过多少成本，浮亏容忍度反而更低，跑得会更快。储备证明让“交易所风险”这件事变得可计算，但可计算的风险不等于没有风险，它只是把不确定性从黑箱挪到了明处。

我自己的判断是：现在这个组合是“尾部风险定价下调 + 上行缺乏杠杆燃料”。前者支撑不跌太深，后者限制涨得太快。要确认方向，我看的不是价格新高，是 8h 费率能不能从 0.0041% 回到 0.0100% 基准之上——费率站上基准，才说明多头开始愿意为仓位付全价，那才是杠杆进场的信号；在那之前，涨是现货的事，跟合约没关系。真正需要小心的从来不是费率飙到高位的时候，是所有人都觉得“已经验证过了、安全了”的时候。

Binance Proof of Reserves reissued: Full zero-knowledge proof for the October 31 snapshot generated; users can independently verify 1:1 backing for 10 major assets

This is a follow-up: the “full zero-knowledge proof, November 3 timeline” mentioned in previous updates has now been delivered. Tonight, Binance posted Recovery Update #5 on its official X account. PANews published it at 20:48 Beijing time, Dongqu followed up at 21:18, and Binance’s official news page confirmed the same details. This step didn’t make it into the previous rounds, so here it is now.

The latest development in one sentence: the full zero-knowledge proof for the Proof of Reserves snapshot taken at 00:00 UTC on October 31 has been generated. Users holding any of these 10 assets—BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD, or ZEC—can now use the PoR verification tool on Binance’s official website to check for themselves whether their balance was included in the snapshot and whether reserves cover it at a ratio of at least 1:1.

Why this step matters: the snapshot itself is just a set of figures reported by Binance; the zero-knowledge proof is what users can actively verify. A Merkle tree proves that your account was included in the snapshot, while a zk-SNARK proves that total reserves cover users’ total balances without revealing anyone else’s balance. Update #3  previously said the full proof would require 40–50 hours of computing and was expected on November 3 (UTC). It has now been completed ahead of schedule, on the evening of November 2.

But it’s important to be clear about what this does—and doesn’t—cover. Don’t mistake this proof for an all-clear:
First, it only covers the point in time at 00:00 UTC on October 31. The cumulative net outflow of $4.72 billion since withdrawals reopened on November 1 is not included in this snapshot;
Second, it only covers the 10 major assets listed above. The remaining approximately 5% in less liquid assets is still being replenished through market and OTC purchases. Binance plans to take another snapshot on November 4 covering more tokens; generating the full proof for that snapshot will take an additional 40–50 hours or so;
Third, it proves that “at that moment, for these 10 assets, reserves covered balances.” It is not a third-party audit and does not cover the platform’s other liabilities.

The current prices of $BTC  are approximately 78,074 (24h +0.06%), and $ETH  are approximately 2,296 (24h +1.10%); both were verified using two sources at 22:39 tonight. Prices haven’t reacted to this news—the market is no longer surprised by the proof being completed. What really matters is what comes next: details on the phased resumption of withdrawals for more networks and assets (PANews says this is planned to move forward tomorrow; Dongqu says details will be announced separately), and whether the November 4 snapshot can expand coverage beyond the 10 major assets.

Background for comparison (old figures, not new developments): approximately $6.3 billion was stolen on October 29; approximately 95% has been replenished; cumulative net outflows are approximately $4.72 billion, or around 2.8% of platform assets (reported at 21:38); the six split XRP wallets still show no new evidence of outbound transfers (reported at 16:38); the stolen funds are still being mixed using CoinJoin, with 28 BTC involved (reported at 20:38).

Risk reminder: a snapshot is proof of reserves at a point in time, not a real-time guarantee. If you haven’t verified your own balance, don’t rely only on reported figures—go to the official PoR page and use the verification tool to check your own balance. Withdrawals for the other assets have not fully reopened, and the phase-two timeline has not yet been announced.

Will you verify your own balance, or wait and see what the November 4 snapshot shows?

新进展就一句话：10 月 31 日 00:00（UTC）那张储备证明快照的完整零知识证明已经生成完毕。持有 BTC、ETH、USDT、BNB、SOL、USDC、XRP、USD1、RLUSD、ZEC 这 10 种币的用户，现在可以用币安官网 PoR 验证工具自己核对——自己的余额有没有被算进快照、储备是不是至少 1:1 覆盖。

为什么这一步关键：快照本身只是币安自己说的数，零知识证明才是用户能动手验的那一步。Merkle 树证明你的账户在快照里，zk-SNARK 证明储备总额盖得住用户总额，又不暴露别人的余额。此前 Update #3 说完整证明要 40–50 小时算力、预计 11 月 3 日（UTC）出，现在是提前在 11 月 2 日晚间落了地。

但边界也要说清楚，别把这张证明读成全盘过关：
第一，它只覆盖 10 月 31 日 00:00（UTC）那个时点，11 月 1 日重开后的 47.2 亿美元累计净流出不在这张快照里；
第二，它只覆盖上述 10 大币种，剩余约 5% 的低流动性币种仍在市场和 OTC 买进补齐，币安计划 11 月 4 日再拍一轮覆盖更多代币的快照，那轮的完整证明还要再算约 40–50 小时；
第三，它证明的是“那一刻、这 10 个币、储备盖得住余额”，不是第三方审计，也不覆盖平台的其他负债。

现价 $BTC 约 78,074（24h +0.06%）、$ETH 约 2,296（24h +1.10%），都是今晚 22:39 双信源实测。价格没跟着这条消息起反应——市场对“证明落地”这件事本身已经不意外了，真正要看的还是下一步：更多网络和资产的提现分阶段恢复细节（PANews 口径称计划明日推进，动区口径为细节另公布），以及 11 月 4 日那轮快照能不能把覆盖面扩到 10 大币种之外。

背景对照（旧数，不作新进展）：10 月 29 日被盗约 63 亿美元；填回约 95%；累计净流出约 47.2 亿美元、约占平台资产 2.8%（21:38 已发）；6 只分拆 XRP 钱包仍无外转新证据（16:38 已发）；赃款混币仍为 28 枚 BTC 的 CoinJoin 口径（20:38 已发）。

风险提示：快照是时点证明，不是实时担保；没验过自己余额的别只听口径，去官网 PoR 页走一遍验证工具才是自己的数；其余币种提现仍未全开，第二阶段时间表还没公布。
