一、以太坊当前价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二日下午，以太坊最新报价为二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点七九。从小时线来看，价格在二千二百七十七美元至二千三百零五美元之间波动，整体呈现小幅反弹后企稳的态势。

回顾近五个小时的K线数据，以太坊在十三点时段触及二千二百七十七美元的日内低点后出现买盘介入，价格一度冲高至二千三百零五美元，随后回落至二千二百八十七美元附近。成交量方面，最近一个完整小时录得约三千四百三十万美元的成交额，较前一小时的二千一百八十四万美元明显放大，显示反弹过程中有资金积极参与。

以太坊近期的走势受到多重因素影响。一方面，美国现货以太坊ETF在十月份录得约十六点一亿美元的净流出，创下自二零二四年七月上市以来的最差月度表现。另一方面，链上数据显示验证者退出队列降至接近零，减少了短期内的抛压。此外，代币化股票市值达到八点二七亿美元，同比增长百分之一百七十，为以太坊生态提供了基本面支撑。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，当前七小时均线约为二千二百九十美元，二十五小时均线约为二千二百八十美元，九十九小时均线约为二千二百六十四美元。短期均线位于中长期均线上方，价格站稳在九十九小时均线之上，中期趋势相对偏多。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线约为五点八六，DEA线约为六点四六，柱状图为负零点六零，空头动能正在减弱。RSI六周期指标快速回升至六十一点二零，十二周期为五十八点九五，二十四周期为五十七点一四，三线均处于中性偏强区域，显示短期反弹动能有所恢复。

布林带方面，上轨约二千三百一十美元，中轨约二千二百八十四美元，下轨约二千二百五十七美元。价格在中轨上方运行，接近上轨位置，短期存在触及上轨后回落的风险。KDJ指标中K值回升至四十一点七八，D值为三十九点九四，J值达到四十五点四四，三线低位金叉后持续上行，短期多头占优。

抛物线SAR指标显示止损位约在二千三百一十三美元，高于当前价格，维持看空信号。综合来看，以太坊技术面相对比特币更为健康，短期反弹结构完整，但需要关注上方二千三百一十美元附近的压力。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪近期呈现分化格局。机构层面，ETF的持续流出反映了部分资金对短期风险的规避态度。但链上数据表明，质押网络的稳定性正在增强，验证者退出意愿极低，说明长期持有者对以太坊的价值依然认可。

值得关注的是，币安黑客事件中约三十二点四亿美元的被盗资产仍以以太坊和比特币形式存在，这部分资金的潜在流动可能对市场价格造成冲击。FBI已向相关节点运营商施压要求冻结涉案资金，THORChain也因事件暂停了互换功能，引发了去中心化与监管合规之间的讨论。

从生态发展角度来看，代币化真实世界资产的持续增长为以太坊提供了新的叙事支撑。随着全球监管机构加速稳定币框架的制定，以太坊作为智能合约平台的地位有望进一步巩固。短期来看，美国中期选举结果将对加密政策走向产生重要影响，市场需要保持耐心等待方向明朗。

热门代币方面，MITO报价零点零零八七零美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十八点零五；HAEDAL报价零点零二七八三美元，涨幅百分之十四点一五；KORUB报价十一点八九美元，涨幅百分之十点八一。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep by My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

First: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Second: Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Third: Never add to a losing position or average down.
Fourth: After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
Fifth: Withdraw some of your profits. The money goes out; the discipline stays.

There are only five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

🚀 Binance: The Future of Cryptocurrency Is Bigger Than We Think!

The world of finance is changing rapidly, and cryptocurrency is becoming an important part of the digital economy. At the center of this transformation is Binance, one of the world's most recognized cryptocurrency platforms.

But what makes Binance so interesting? It's not just about buying and selling digital assets. It's about technology, innovation, security, and the future of digital finance.

🌍 The Cryptocurrencies Everyone Is Watching

Let's talk about some of the biggest names in crypto:

🟠 Bitcoin (BTC): Often called digital gold, Bitcoin remains one of the most recognized cryptocurrencies.

🔵 Ethereum (ETH): More than a digital currency, Ethereum supports smart contracts and decentralized applications.

🟡 BNB: Binance's ecosystem token, used across various Binance services and applications.

💵 USDT: A stablecoin designed to follow the value of the US dollar, making it an important part of crypto trading and transfers.

💜 XRP: A cryptocurrency associated with blockchain-based payment solutions.

Each cryptocurrency has a different purpose, technology, and level of risk.

🔥 Why Does Binance Attract So Much Attention?

Binance brings several crypto-related services together in one ecosystem. Users can explore market information, learn about blockchain technology, discover new projects, and access different digital assets.

Another important feature is Binance Academy, where beginners can learn about cryptocurrency, blockchain, and digital security.

📊 The Future: Opportunity Meets Responsibility

The cryptocurrency market never stops evolving. Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, and other digital currencies continue to attract attention from people interested in blockchain technology.

However, one thing should never be forgotten: crypto prices can rise and fall dramatically. Research, patience, and understanding the risks are more important than following social media hype.

💡 My Final Thoughts

Binance represents more than a cryptocurrency platform. It is part of a much bigger conversation about how technology could transform the future of money.

The real question is not simply which cryptocurrency will become popular next.

The real question is: Are we ready to understand the future of digital finance? 🚀

一、以太坊当前价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二日下午，以太坊最新报价为二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点七九。从小时线来看，价格在二千二百七十七美元至二千三百零五美元之间波动，整体呈现小幅反弹后企稳的态势。

回顾近五个小时的K线数据，以太坊在十三点时段触及二千二百七十七美元的日内低点后出现买盘介入，价格一度冲高至二千三百零五美元，随后回落至二千二百八十七美元附近。成交量方面，最近一个完整小时录得约三千四百三十万美元的成交额，较前一小时的二千一百八十四万美元明显放大，显示反弹过程中有资金积极参与。

以太坊近期的走势受到多重因素影响。一方面，美国现货以太坊ETF在十月份录得约十六点一亿美元的净流出，创下自二零二四年七月上市以来的最差月度表现。另一方面，链上数据显示验证者退出队列降至接近零，减少了短期内的抛压。此外，代币化股票市值达到八点二七亿美元，同比增长百分之一百七十，为以太坊生态提供了基本面支撑。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，当前七小时均线约为二千二百九十美元，二十五小时均线约为二千二百八十美元，九十九小时均线约为二千二百六十四美元。短期均线位于中长期均线上方，价格站稳在九十九小时均线之上，中期趋势相对偏多。

MACD指标方面，DIFF线约为五点八六，DEA线约为六点四六，柱状图为负零点六零，空头动能正在减弱。RSI六周期指标快速回升至六十一点二零，十二周期为五十八点九五，二十四周期为五十七点一四，三线均处于中性偏强区域，显示短期反弹动能有所恢复。

布林带方面，上轨约二千三百一十美元，中轨约二千二百八十四美元，下轨约二千二百五十七美元。价格在中轨上方运行，接近上轨位置，短期存在触及上轨后回落的风险。KDJ指标中K值回升至四十一点七八，D值为三十九点九四，J值达到四十五点四四，三线低位金叉后持续上行，短期多头占优。

抛物线SAR指标显示止损位约在二千三百一十三美元，高于当前价格，维持看空信号。综合来看，以太坊技术面相对比特币更为健康，短期反弹结构完整，但需要关注上方二千三百一十美元附近的压力。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪近期呈现分化格局。机构层面，ETF的持续流出反映了部分资金对短期风险的规避态度。但链上数据表明，质押网络的稳定性正在增强，验证者退出意愿极低，说明长期持有者对以太坊的价值依然认可。

值得关注的是，币安黑客事件中约三十二点四亿美元的被盗资产仍以以太坊和比特币形式存在，这部分资金的潜在流动可能对市场价格造成冲击。FBI已向相关节点运营商施压要求冻结涉案资金，THORChain也因事件暂停了互换功能，引发了去中心化与监管合规之间的讨论。

从生态发展角度来看，代币化真实世界资产的持续增长为以太坊提供了新的叙事支撑。随着全球监管机构加速稳定币框架的制定，以太坊作为智能合约平台的地位有望进一步巩固。短期来看，美国中期选举结果将对加密政策走向产生重要影响，市场需要保持耐心等待方向明朗。

热门代币方面，MITO报价零点零零八七零美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十八点零五；HAEDAL报价零点零二七八三美元，涨幅百分之十四点一五；KORUB报价十一点八九美元，涨幅百分之十点八一。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year means 12x your money; earning a steady 10% a month
means 30x your money over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but there’s something remarkable about it—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities are something you wait for, while discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week.” Set it as “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability to achieve the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

Crypto Mini-Lesson: Upgradeable Contracts
EIP-1967 specifies standard storage locations for proxy contracts to store the addresses of their logic contracts and administrators, making it easier for block explorers and wallets to recognize proxy contracts.
After an Ethereum contract is deployed, its bytecode itself cannot be modified. Projects that support upgrades generally use the proxy pattern to achieve this.

title: 跌的没破位、涨的没量，这盘在等什么？
subTitle:
跌的没破位、涨的没量，这盘在等什么？

手上还有货的人，这会儿大概在算两笔账。一笔是这两天跌下来没走的浮亏，另一笔是万一这里真是底的踏空。两笔都算不清，因为盘面既没给出该走的理由，也没给出该加的理由。我翻了一遍十个币的读数，能给的最实在的答案是：这个位置，多空都没在用力。

先说跌得最狠的那个。LINK 二十四小时 -1.96%，十个币里垫底，但过去四小时它涨得最多，+0.66%。同一份数据里还有几处对不上：RSI 42.6 是十币最高，布林带位置 25.8% 最高，三十日区间分位 27.0% 也是最高。跌得最多，位置却最高，说明它前面跌得比人家少，现在在补。$LINK 现价 11.368，MA99 在 11.4253，差 0.5%，还没真跌破。二十四小时低点 11.226 也没摸到三十日低点 10.273。ATR 5.81%，波动是十币里最大的两个之一，这种票一根针就能把止损扫掉。

再看量能。ETH 的成交量对七日均量是 0.76，其余九个在 0.05 到 0.56 之间，只有它接近七成。价格上 ETH 二十四小时 +1.15%，十二小时 +0.15%，四小时 +0.10%，三个时间维度都收正。$ETH 现价 2293.15，MA7 在 2290.40，刚站上去 0.1%，MA25 2389.22 还压在头上 4%。RSI 37.5，仍在弱区。量放出来了价格却没走出去，这种组合我读成低位有人在接，但接的人也不急。

大盘这边，BTC 报 78040，二十四小时 +0.12%，看着是红的，拆开就不是了：十二小时 -0.48%，四小时 -0.05%，涨幅是白天留下的，最近这一段没再往前走。二十四小时区间 77602.72 到 78878.01，现价落在 34% 的位置，靠下。MA7 78798.56 在上方压着，MA99 76712.71 在下方 1.7% 托着，中间这段就是它现在的活动范围。ATR 2.45%，十币最低，波动被压得很扁。

站上 MA99 的还有两个。BNB 706.06，二十四小时 -1.27%，MA99 701.91 仍在脚下 0.6%，布林带位置 16.0%。AVAX 8.615，跌 1.92%，第二狠，但 MA99 8.429 也没丢，离它有 2.2%。XRP 1.2591，涨 0.57%，二十四小时区间位置 75%，三个时间维度也都是正的，只是幅度比 ETH 小一截，而且连 MA7 1.2733 都还没收回。原本 LINK 也在这条线上，今天掉下去了，所以站上 MA99 的从四个减到三个。

位置更靠下的几个，问题各不相同。SOL 报 94.56，RSI 29.0 进超卖，布林带位置 5.4%，三十日区间分位 7.4%，三项都是十币最低。它离布林下轨 93.70 只剩 0.9%，三十日低点 92.34 就在脚下。ADA 0.1912，跌 1.19%，离 MA25 有 11.89%，是偏离最远的一个，三十日分位 9.2%，二十四小时低点 0.1897 距布林下轨 0.1846 也不远。DOGE 0.07554，跌 0.30%，RSI 35.4，布林位置 15.1%，没什么动作。TON 要单独提：二十四小时 +0.95%，四小时 -0.99%，是四小时跌得最多的一个，把涨幅吐回去了；量能 0.05，十币最低，几乎没人交易；MACD 柱 +0.003564，十个币里只有它在零轴上方；价格 1.60 还站在 MA7 1.5814 上面。这三个读数凑一起，更像没人管，不像有人砸。

把这十行数字叠起来，二十四小时四个红六个绿，十二小时两个红八个绿，四小时七个红三个绿。中午那段十二小时是今天最差的窗口，四小时这一段全体回来一点，但幅度全在 1% 以内，最大的 LINK 也只有 0.66%。量能对七日均量 0.05 到 0.76，没有一个过八成。价格在四小时上转正、量能没跟上，我倾向读成卖压暂停，不是买盘进场。三十日区间分位十币全落在 9.2% 到 27.0%，都在底部三成以内，往下压和往上冲的空间都不大。

接下来我只盯位置，不讲方向。BTC 若收在 MA99 76712 下方，76325.98 那个三十日低点就要重新测试，站上 MA99 的会从三个继续减。SOL 若破 92.34，超卖就不再算支撑，ADA 和 DOGE 大概率跟着走。反过来，BTC 若收回 MA7 78798 并且量能对七日均量过一倍，这轮横盘才算有点往上的意思；收不回去，就还是 76712 到 78798 之间来回磨。

这份读数取的是北京时间 21:49 的快照，比午间晚了大半天，价格已经换过几轮，看的时候对着实时价再校一遍。仓位怎么摆是你自己的事，别把别人的判断直接当止损位用。

translatedData.content:
Binance withdrawal tally updated: cumulative net outflows of about $4.72 billion, with another roughly $1.08 billion out after day one

This is a belated update: Reuters published these figures at 18:42 this afternoon, but they didn’t make it into the previous rounds, so here’s the missing piece. This isn’t a new wave of withdrawals tonight; it’s the second update to the cumulative tally.

First, let’s reconcile the figures—don’t mix these two up:
Day-one tally (November 1, 14:00–23:30 Beijing time, according to Binance’s official figures): $4.649 billion withdrawn and $1.01 billion deposited, for net outflows of about $3.64 billion, equal to 2.1% of the $171 billion in assets reported in the October 28 proof of reserves.
Cumulative tally (Reuters cited a Binance spokesperson this afternoon; same basis as Bloomberg): since withdrawals reopened on the morning of November 1, cumulative net outflows have reached about $4.72 billion, or roughly 2.8% of platform assets. Subtracting the two figures, about another $1.08 billion flowed out net after the day-one window.

In terms of what it means, this is still “a surge followed by a pullback,” not a second bank run. Binance’s statement on X remains that “after an initial spike, withdrawal volumes have declined and stabilized, while deposits remain substantial.” The Reuters report also offered two points of comparison: in the week after Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in 2023, about $7 billion in Circle’s USDC flowed out; in the 72 hours after FTX collapsed in December 2022, Binance itself saw net outflows of about $6 billion. This time’s $4.72 billion has not reached either of those levels.

A note on methodology is also important: the $4.72 billion figure is the official figure provided by a Binance spokesperson. Don’t mix it with DefiLlama’s wallet-tracking methodology—the post at 18:38 explained that it includes transfers between the exchange’s own wallets. A Binance spokesperson has disputed its accuracy; the two figures are not from the same ledger.

Current prices: $BTC  about $78,064 (24h +0.16%) and $ETH  about $2,296 (24h +1.32%), both checked against two sources at 21:39 tonight. Prices haven’t fallen alongside the outflow figures, suggesting that the market is currently pricing this as “manageable withdrawals,” not as “the platform is in trouble.”

Background for comparison (older figures, not new developments): about $6.3 billion stolen on October 29; withdrawals on 15 chains resumed on November 1, with about 95% restored and the remaining roughly 5% in low-liquidity tokens; fiat withdrawals for five currencies resumed this afternoon (reported at 17:38); the full zero-knowledge proof of reserves remains based on figures from November 3, and no timeline for the second phase has been announced.

Risk note: $4.72 billion is cumulative net outflows according to a spokesperson, not a third-party audit figure. Withdrawals for most tokens have not fully reopened, and fees and limits, as well as the second-phase arrangements, are still pending. Don’t interpret “stabilized” as “fully restored.”

Which side are you on: has this stabilized, or is a second wave still to come?

币安提现账单更新：累计净流出约 47.2 亿美元，首日之后又走了约 10.8 亿

这篇是补发：路透今天下午 18:42 就刊发了这组数，前面几轮没排上，现在把账补齐——它不是今天晚上的新提现潮，而是累计账单的第二次更新。

先对账，两个数别混：
首日账（11 月 1 日 14:00–23:30 北京时间，币安官方口径）：提现 46.49 亿美元、存入 10.1 亿美元，净流出约 36.4 亿美元，占 10 月 28 日储备证明口径 1,710 亿美元资产的 2.1%。
累计账（路透今天下午引币安发言人、彭博同口径）：自 11 月 1 日上午重开以来，累计净流出约 47.2 亿美元，约占平台资产的 2.8%。两数相减，首日窗口之后又净走了约 10.8 亿美元。

定性上这仍是“放量后回落”，不是第二波挤兑：币安在 X 上的说法仍是“起初冲高后，提现量已下降并趋稳、存入量仍可观”；路透稿还给了两个参照——2023 年硅谷银行倒闭后一周，Circle 的 USDC 约走了 70 亿美元；2022 年 12 月 FTX 倒闭后 72 小时，币安自己也走过约 60 亿美元净流出。这次的 47.2 亿还没到那两个量级。

口径提醒也很重要：这 47.2 亿是币安发言人给的官方口径，别跟 DefiLlama 那套钱包追踪口径混着用——那套 18:38 帖里讲过，含交易所自有钱包之间的划转，币安发言人已质疑它不准确，两个数不是同一本账。

现价 $BTC 约 78,064（24h +0.16%）、$ETH 约 2,296（24h +1.32%），都是今晚 21:39 双信源实测。价格没跟着流出数字一起砸，说明市场目前是按“可控的提款”在定价，不是按“平台要出事”在定价。

背景对照（旧数，不作新进展）：10 月 29 日被盗约 63 亿美元；11 月 1 日 15 条链提现恢复、填回约 95%、剩余约 5% 为低流动性币种；今天下午法币 5 币种提现恢复（17:38 已发）；完整零知识储备证明仍为 11 月 3 日口径，第二阶段时间表仍未公布。

风险提示：47.2 亿是发言人口径的累计净流出，不是第三方审计数；大部分代币提现仍未全开，手续费与限额、第二阶段安排都还没兑现，别把“趋稳”读成“全恢复”。

Just two days ago, we mentioned that Michael Saylor’s MicroStrategy had increased its stock purchases. Now it has gone the other way and spent another $65.5 million to buy 811 bitcoins. The underlying reason is MicroStrategy’s long-term bullish stance on Bitcoin and its ability to act on it. The company not only disclosed an increase in its Bitcoin holdings in its financial report, but also demonstrated through its actions how institutional investors are reallocating to digital assets in the wake of FTX. Given that Bitcoin makes up as much as 200% of its holdings, this move is not an isolated event, but a typical example of institutional capital continuing to flow into the crypto market. It means institutional demand for Bitcoin remains strong. This is especially true when sentiment in traditional financial markets is subdued, as digital assets have become a new outlet for capital seeking a safe haven and growth.

Market impact
The immediate effect is a boost to short-term sentiment around BTC, particularly given that MicroStrategy clearly stated during its earnings call that Bitcoin is an important reserve asset. This could encourage some traditional institutional investors to continue allocating to digital assets, but the medium- to long-term trend depends more on Bitcoin’s own fundamentals. In terms of capital flows, this means there is additional buying support for Bitcoin around 77K. However, given the company’s large-scale stock purchases in recent days, it remains to be seen whether it will continue to be a net buyer of Bitcoin or redirect funds back into equities. In similar historical cases, large institutional acquisitions have usually taken place during market pullbacks. This disclosure provides a strong reason for support around 77K–78K for BTC. If Bitcoin holds firm in this range, it could attract more institutional capital. This thesis may only gain further traction if MicroStrategy discloses another net purchase of Bitcoin next quarter.

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。Strive最近大手笔买了124枚比特币，一下子让它在机构比特币储备竞赛中追平了Metaplanet。这事儿发生在加密货币钱包管理领域，意味着钱怎么进钱包、怎么存，成了比钱包本身更重要的话题。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Strive此举根本原因不是比特币本身，而是它在抢夺整个加密行业最稀缺的资源——资金存取渠道。以前大家关心谁做钱包，现在更关心谁掌握资金阀门。比特币在这里是个流量密码，就像前两天说的砸钱买股一样，本质是看中Strive这种机构的资金运作能力。

对市场的影响

操作思路

The impact on ETH may be indirect, but ETH’s recent strength suggests that funds are seeking assets with diversified sources of value.

subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You're Holding On to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Deceiving You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? “The all-time high,” thinking: If it gets back to my cost basis,
I'll get out. Remember, this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn't know your cost basis,
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you've decided to ride out a position, you'll automatically seek out bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You'll feel
“This time is different”—those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the rationale for this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding the position, and only then can you see

😤 The second it closed at 1.0802, my finger hovered over the confirm button—5.8x volume, a bullish candle. Looked pretty intimidating.

That $BTW 15m candle had absolutely explosive volume.

💀 But one look at the bigger picture brought me back to my senses: the 1h bears are still lurking below the moving-average cluster, and the 4h bulls have already fallen below it. 【The hack has put ETH’s funding picture in the spotlight】

The FBI has confirmed that North Korea was linked to the Binance hack, which involved $6 billion, and has asked the DeFi community to block the associated BTC, ETH, and SOL addresses. Reports say the exchange has resumed withdrawals; there is currently no evidence that AI was involved in the attack. THORChain also paused cross-chain swaps across multiple networks, including ETH, due to a block-reorganization vulnerability. First, separate what’s confirmed from what isn’t—that’s how you avoid being swept up in the emotions.

I’d rather talk about a core ETH concept: ETF fund flows. You can think of them as the “reservoir gates” through which institutional money enters the market. In October, ETH-related ETFs saw monthly net outflows of $1.61 billion, a record, yet ETH was still up 1% over the past 24 hours and down 2.1% over the past 7 days, while the Fear and Greed Index stood at just 37. This shows that price hasn’t followed fund flows completely; the market is waiting for a clearer signal of fresh inflows.

So, who is actually affected? ETF holders feel the pressure of fund flows at the product level. DeFi users face the risks of address tracking, reduced liquidity, and trading disruptions—THORChain’s swap suspension is a concrete example. Does the business logic hold up? Yes. ETF fund flows reflect real demand, while on-chain address tracking is a security measure, but neither can tell you directly where the bottom is.

Remember this: when fear is high, first check whether money is flowing back in. Don’t just focus on a single candlestick.

What do you think is happening with ETH’s funding picture—is it bottoming out, or is the sell-off continuing? Would you like to learn more about ETF fund flows or on-chain tracking?

content:
【黑客事件把ETH的资金面推到台前】

FBI已确认朝鲜方面与Binance遭黑客攻击、涉及60亿美元资金有关，并要求DeFi社区封锁相关BTC、ETH、SOL地址。据报道，交易所已恢复提款；目前没有证据证明AI参与了这次攻击。THORChain也因区块重组漏洞暂停了包含ETH在内的多网络互换。先把已确认和未确认分清，后面才不会被情绪带着走。

我更想讲一个ETH的核心概念：ETF资金流。你可以把它理解成机构资金进入市场的“水库闸门”。10月ETH相关ETF月度净流出16.1亿美元，创下纪录，但ETH近24小时仍涨1%，7日跌2.1%，恐惧贪婪指数只有37。这说明价格没有完全跟着资金流走，市场在等更明确的增量信号。

落到实处，谁会受影响？ETF持有人感受到的是产品层面的资金压力；DeFi用户要承担地址追踪、流动性下降和交易中断的风险，THORChain暂停互换就是具体例子。商业逻辑通不通？通。ETF资金流是真实需求，链上地址追踪则是安全机制，但两者都不能直接替你判断底部。

记住这一点：恐惧时先看资金有没有回来，不要只看一根K线。

translatedData.content:
My observation is that, in this Binance theft, what is really worth tracking is not “how much money the hackers took,” but the different states the funds have been split into: still in linked addresses, frozen, or already mixed. Conflating these three makes it easy to overestimate short-term selling pressure and underestimate the difficulty of recovery.

According to data Elliptic provided to PANews, as of 15:30 Beijing time on November 2, about $3.24 billion in stolen assets remained in related addresses, mainly ETH and BTC; about $2.85 billion had been frozen or seized. Money-laundering activity involved 11 blockchains, around 12,000 wallets, and more than 40,000 transactions in less than four days. As of 14:02 that day, about 28 BTC had passed through 18 CoinJoin mixing rounds. These figures reflect a single analytics firm’s methodology; the materials provided for this article contain no independent verification by other firms.

On this basis, a freeze does not mean recovery, and mixing does not mean cashing out. If frozen assets subsequently enter a return or disposal process, their impact on ETH and BTC liquidity will depend on the timing, method, and counterparties; the materials provided here do not include those details. For now, the portion that has actually been sold on the open market can only be inferred from Elliptic’s assessment that “possibly only a very small amount of funds has been cashed out”—it should not be treated as a confirmed fact.

My observation is that three indicators are more important to watch in the short term: whether balances in linked addresses continue to decline, whether the number of CoinJoin transactions increases, and whether exchanges or law enforcement agencies issue new freeze announcements. If the first two accelerate at the same time while the amount frozen stops growing, that would indicate funds are shifting from “interceptable” to “difficult to trace.” If the amount frozen continues to rise, expectations for recovery should be reassessed. Reliance on a single firm’s methodology is the biggest limitation of this analysis; this article does not constitute investment advice.

我的观察是：这起币安被盗案里，真正值得跟踪的不是“黑客拿走了多少钱”，而是资金被切成了几种不同状态——仍在关联地址、已被冻结、已进入混币。把这三者混为一谈，容易高估短期抛压，也容易低估追回难度。

按Elliptic向PANews提供的数据，截至北京时间11月2日15:30，约32.4亿美元被盗资产仍在相关地址，主要为ETH和BTC；约28.5亿美元已被冻结或扣押。洗钱活动在不到四天内涉及11条区块链、约1.2万个钱包和超过4万笔交易；截至当日14:02，约28枚BTC经过18次CoinJoin混币。这些数字来自单一分析机构口径，本次素材未提供其他机构的独立核对。

据此推断，冻结不等于追回，混币也不等于变现。被冻结资产若后续进入返还或处置程序，其对ETH、BTC流动性的影响取决于时间、方式和对手方，本次素材未提供这些细节。真正进入公开市场抛售的部分，目前只能从Elliptic“可能仅有极少资金被变现”这一机构判断中推测，不能当作已确认事实。

我的观察是，短期更该盯三个指标：关联地址余额是否持续下降、CoinJoin笔数是否放大、以及是否有交易所或执法方发布新的冻结公告。若前两项同时加速而冻结规模不再扩大，说明资金正从“可拦截”转向“难追踪”；若冻结金额继续上升，则追回预期需要重估。单一机构口径是这套判断最大的局限，本文不构成投资建议。

📰 Could AI drug discovery send capital markets into a frenzy? Why is this breakthrough by Mistral Large 4 so significant for BTC/ETH?

French AI company Mistral has released its latest model, Mistral Large 4, which can generate 3D molecular structures from simple instructions and solve problems in quantum chemistry. This marks another step forward for AI applications in fields such as materials science and drug discovery—and breakthroughs like this often prompt markets to reassess AI’s value.

Why does this news matter?
Put simply, this is a landmark moment in AI’s shift from “writing code/drawing pictures” to “doing scientific research.” In the past, processing molecular structures with AI required professional chemists to write complex algorithms. Now, ordinary users can generate 3D molecular models with natural-language prompts. Behind this is a leap in AI’s multimodal understanding: models need to understand not only natural language, but also scientific principles.

What does this mean? It means that over the next few years, AI applications in scientific research could grow exponentially. Global investment in drug discovery is currently around $500 billion. If AI can improve efficiency by 15–20%, it could add trillions of dollars in market value. And what the crypto world values most is the narrative of an “efficiency revolution”—Mistral’s breakthrough provides just the right material for it.

Impact on the market
Let’s look directly at the numbers: global AI investment exceeded $10 billion in Q1 2024, with nearly 30% going to scientific computing. What does this breakthrough by Mistral mean? It means AI’s value could shift entirely from “entertainment tool” to “productivity tool.” For crypto assets, this is an important upgrade to the narrative.

Although the positive impact on BTC and ETH in the short term is likely to be felt mostly in market sentiment, AI-powered scientific computing could generate many new applications over the long term. For example, AI-assisted drug discovery could drive synergies between digital assets and the healthcare sector. Historically, whenever a major technological breakthrough occurs (see the metaverse hype in 2020), markets usually need 2–3 months to digest the positive news. The market is now at a point where it needs a new narrative to provide a boost.

Trading strategy
Mistral’s breakthrough has validated the “AI for scientific research” sector, which is its most direct impact on the crypto market. BTC at $77,948 and ETH at $2,290 have already priced in some of the positive news. If no other major events rock the market over the next month, this breakthrough could support Bitcoin trading sideways in the $75K–$80K range. This outlook is void if Mistral makes a major breakthrough in quantum chemistry going forward—for example, developing an algorithm that can cut drug discovery timelines by 50%.

法国AI公司Mistral发布了最新模型Mistral Large 4，能在简单指令下生成3D分子结构并解决量子化学问题。这标志着AI在材料科学、药物研发等领域的应用又往前推进一步，而这类技术突破往往会引发市场对AI价值重估。

简单说，这是AI从"写代码/画画"进入"搞科研"的标志性事件。过去AI要处理分子结构需要专业化学家编写复杂算法，现在普通用户就能通过自然语言指令生成3D分子模型。这背后是AI多模态理解能力的跃迁——模型不仅要懂自然语言，还要能理解科学原理。

意味着什么？意味着未来几年AI在科研领域的应用场景会呈指数级增长。目前全球药物研发投入约5000亿美元，如果AI能提高15-20%的效率，市场价值可能新增数万亿美元空间。而加密世界最看重的就是"效率革命"叙事，Mistral的突破正好提供了这个素材。

对市场的影响
直接看数据：2024年Q1全球AI投资已超百亿美元，其中近30%流向了科学计算领域。Mistral这个突破意味着什么？意味着AI的价值可能从"娱乐工具"彻底转向"生产工具"。对加密资产而言，这是一个重要的叙事升级。

虽然短期内BTC和ETH受利好影响更多体现在情绪层面，但长期看AI科学计算会催生大量应用场景。比如AI辅助的药物研发会带动数字资产在医疗板块的联动。从历史来看，每当出现重大科技突破时（参考2020年元宇宙概念），市场总需要2-3个月消化这个利好。现在行情正好处于一个需要新叙事刺激的阶段。

操作思路
Mistral的突破对加密市场最直接的影响是验证了"AI赋能科研"这个赛道。当前$77,948的BTC和$2,290的ETH已经部分消化了这个利好。如果未来一个月内没有其他重大事件冲击，这个突破会支撑比特币继续在$75K-$80K区间震荡。而以太坊受影响更大，因为它在Layer1领域一直强调AI+Web3的结合。如果ETH能在$2250这个位置站稳，突破$2400的可能性会增加。

如果Mistral后续能实现量子化学领域的重大突破（比如开发出能缩短药物研发周期50%的算法），这个判断作废。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn't Admitting You're Wrong—It's the Ticket You Buy for Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to cut their losses because they see a stop-loss as proof that they were wrong, and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and that small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most composed traders I've seen are the quickest to admit when they're wrong. Because they know that whether a trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
This is an entry ticket, not a verdict.

Can an interbank tokenized transaction still be settled on a weekend night? The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) moved the answer one step closer today.

On November 2, the HKMA announced that Project Ensemble’s pilot phase, EnsembleTX, has entered a new stage: participating banks can use “tokenized central bank money” to settle interbank tokenized deposits, with settlement available around the clock, 24/7. The number of participating banks has risen to 12, and the number of industry pioneers to 20.

A few points that directly affect everyday people 👇
🔹 Previously, the pilot mainly ran on Hong Kong dollar RTGS, so it was constrained by traditional clearing hours. This time, tokenized central bank money serves as the “foundation”—with the aim of enabling genuine overnight settlement.
🔹 Authorized dealers have completed secondary-market trial transactions in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills. The HKMA says licensed stablecoins will be included in similar trials next.
🔹 At the same Hong Kong FinTech Week event, HSBC Group CEO revealed that RedCoin, a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, had reached 50,000 users around 10 days after launch. Since October 23, it has been available for transfers and merchant payments in PayMe. More than 3.3 million PayMe customers can activate a stablecoin wallet. HSBC also said it aims to reach “millions” of users and plans to connect it to use cases such as mobile banking and subscriptions to tokenized money market funds.
🔹 Retail use (spending RedCoin in PayMe) and institutional use (24/7 interbank settlement through Ensemble) are two separate tracks. Don’t conflate them and assume “everyone in the city can already use stablecoins to buy groceries around the clock.”

Put simply, Hong Kong is pushing forward on two fronts at once: “Can interbank transactions be settled overnight?” and “Can licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoins be used for everyday payments?” Have you used the PayMe stablecoin wallet in Hong Kong, or are you more interested in when interbank settlement will really take off?

A protocol suddenly changes its contract logic. Will it affect the coins users have deposited?
Upgradability lets a project fix vulnerabilities and launch new features. The trade-off is that users must trust whoever holds the upgrade privileges not to make unauthorized changes or lose their private keys.
When an upgrade happens, an account with upgrade privileges changes the proxy contract to point to a new logic contract. The address users interact with stays the same, but the logic being executed changes.
Understanding this won’t make me better overnight, but it can help me avoid a few basic mistakes.
Every potential gain comes with its own risks. First, understand the worst-case scenario.

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune at Risk, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound a few times
and multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Compounding Positions Involves】Instead of cashing out floating profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding is incredible; once it stops, floating profits
of dozens of points can vanish to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts you see about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year gives you 12x your money; earning a steady 10% a month
gives you 30x your money over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but there’s something remarkable about it—it doesn’t rely on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities come when they come; discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The market gives you the money in the first case;
in the second, the ability is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are entitled to keep playing.

After Arthur Hayes closed out his positions on October 24, ENA, ETHFI, and ETH fell along with the broader market. The on-chain timing looks remarkably precise. But I’d first like to put forward a falsifiable assessment: these data can prove that “the move happened before the decline,” but they are not enough to prove that he “predicted the decline.” In my view, on-chain records are good at reconstructing the sequence of actions, but not the motives behind decisions. Conflating the two can make a coincidental bit of timing look like a smart-money signal.

According to monitoring by on-chain analyst Ai Yi, cited by PANews, during this downturn ENA fell from $0.196 to $0.169, a decline of 13.77%; ETHFI fell from $0.6499 to $0.5727, down 11.87%; ETH fell from $2,375 to $2,257, down 4.96%; and UNI fell from $6.93 to $6.91, down just 0.28%. These figures come from a single source. The materials provided here do not include information on the address’s subsequent actions, position size, or trading depth.

Based on this, the mechanism worth watching is liquidity stratification: the larger the position, the more its exit depends on counterparties absorbing the sale, so the act of selling can itself put pressure on prices. Therefore, “prices fell after the positions were closed” has another possible explanation: the selling contributed to some of the decline, rather than the seller simply avoiding it. Whether this explanation holds depends on whether the decline was driven mainly by spot selling pressure or leveraged liquidations. The materials provided here do not include liquidation data, so this cannot be determined.

There are three things to check: whether the address buys back at lower prices; whether other similarly large addresses also reduce their positions; and how the ratio of spot trading to liquidations changes during any subsequent decline. If the address buys back, it would look more like swing trading. If similar addresses all sell and spot selling pressure dominates, that would be closer to a structural retreat. Until then, I would treat this as a verifiable record of activity, not as a decision-making approach that can be replicated. This article does not constitute investment advice.

$ETH

#ETH #Crypto Market

content:
Arthur Hayes在10月24日清仓后，ENA、ETHFI、ETH随大盘下跌，链上时点看起来很准。但我想先提出一个可被推翻的判断：这组数据能证明“动作发生在下跌前”，却不足以证明“预判了下跌”。我的观察是，链上记录擅长还原操作顺序，不擅长还原决策动机，把两者混为一谈，容易把一次时点巧合读成聪明钱信号。

据PANews援引链上分析师Ai姨的监测，这轮下跌中ENA从0.196美元跌至0.169美元，跌幅13.77%；ETHFI从0.6499美元跌至0.5727美元，跌11.87%；ETH从2375美元跌至2257美元，跌4.96%；UNI从6.93美元跌至6.91美元，仅跌0.28%。这是单一来源的监测数据，本次素材未提供该地址后续操作、仓位规模或成交深度的信息。

据此推断，值得关注的机制是流动性分层：持仓越大，退出越依赖对手盘承接，减持本身就可能对价格形成压力。因此“清仓后下跌”存在另一种解释——卖出行为贡献了部分跌幅，而非纯粹躲开。这一解释是否成立，取决于下跌由现货抛压还是杠杆清算主导，本次素材未提供清算数据，无法判断。

验证条件有三：该地址是否在更低位置回补；同类大额地址是否同步减持；后续下跌中现货成交与清算的比例如何变化。若出现回补，说明更像波段操作；若同类地址集体减持且现货抛压占主导，才更接近结构性撤退。在此之前，我倾向于把它当作可核验的操作记录，而不是可复制的判断依据。本文不构成投资建议。

Will South Koreans really start paying taxes on crypto in 2027? The ruling party is now leaning toward delaying it again.

On November 3, Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers on the National Assembly’s Strategy and Finance Committee reached an agreement to recommend to party leadership that taxation on virtual assets be postponed to allow more time to prepare. After a committee meeting, ruling-party secretary Oh Ki-hyung (오기형) said most members were discussing a further delay of about two years—moving the start date from January 1, 2027, to around 2029.

A few points that directly affect ordinary people 👇
🔹 Current framework: The portion of annual gains exceeding about 2.5 million won (classified as other income) is taxed at around 22% (including local tax). The start date has already been postponed three times and was set for New Year’s Day 2027.
🔹 Why they want to delay it again: Cross-border crypto tax information exchange (CARF) is not expected to be fully in place until around 2029; if the Digital Asset Basic Act takes shape in the first half of next year, the basis for taxation could change; and transaction-data and tax-enforcement systems still need further testing.
🔹 Not yet written into law: This is a recommendation from the committee to party leadership. It must be discussed by the policy committee, and the date can only be changed through an amendment to the Income Tax Act. Within the party, some are saying, “Don’t delay it a fourth time.”
🔹 The window for action: If they do decide to postpone it, discussions on the relevant amendments will need to move forward in the coming weeks. Otherwise, the original schedule—New Year’s Day 2027—will remain in place.

For people trading in South Korea, the short-term takeaway is that “the tax rules aren’t finalized yet.” Don’t sell everything or move your assets based on the assumption that taxation will definitely begin in 2027, and don’t believe rumors that a delay until 2029 has already been confirmed. Keeping an eye on the National Assembly’s amendment text and National Tax Service announcements is more reliable than following headlines.

Do you think taxation should start on schedule, or should they first get the infrastructure and cross-border information exchange in order?

What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche’s C-Chain, and many Layer 2 networks are EVM-compatible, so Ethereum wallets and development tools can usually be used directly.
“EVM compatibility” lets developers write a contract once and deploy it across multiple chains. It also means that similar contract vulnerabilities may exist on several chains at the same time.
When a contract is called on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
It’s okay to go a little slower. Staying in the game is far more important than making a lot in one go.

#ETH

content:
EVM 到底是什么，“EVM 兼容”又是什么意思？
BNB Smart Chain、Avalanche 的 C 链和很多二层网络都兼容 EVM，以太坊的钱包和开发工具通常可以直接沿用。

在以太坊上调用合约，EVM 每执行一步都根据指令收 Gas，用 $ETH 支付。
慢一点没关系，留在场内要比一次赚得多重要得多。

截至北京时间十一月三日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报二千二百五十八点八美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点三八。盘中价格在二千二百四十九美元至二千二百六十三美元之间窄幅波动，成交量较前期有所萎缩。ETH整体走势弱于BTC，面临较大的抛压。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，当前价格低于七周期均线二千二百五十五美元附近，远低于二十五周期均线二千二百七十五美元和九十九周期均线二千二百五十七美元。值得注意的是，九十九周期均线与当前价格非常接近，说明ETH正处于关键均线争夺区域。七周期均线持续下行，短期趋势偏空。

MACD指标显示，DIFF线报负六点一八，DEA线报负四点二七，柱状图为负一点九一。MACD持续运行在零轴下方，且DIFF线与DEA线的差距仍在扩大，空头趋势未改。不过柱状图负值从负四点零四逐步收窄至负一点九一，下行动能在边际减弱。

RSI六周期指标报三十七点三，处于偏弱区域但已脱离此前十四点八的极度超卖水平。RSI十二报三十九点四，RSI二十四报四十四点三，各周期RSI均在中性偏弱区间运行，显示市场缺乏明确方向。KDJ指标中K线升至四十七点一，D线升至三十七点七，J线达到六十五点八，短期有向上动能但尚未形成强势突破。

布林带方面，价格在中轨二千二百七十美元下方运行，接近下轨二千二百三十八美元。带宽持续收窄，标准差从三点七九降至一点八六，表明波动率显著降低，市场正在酝酿方向性突破。

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Refuse to Cut a Losing Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking to themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Pay attention: this thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you start stubbornly holding a position, you automatically collect good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned through more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to do: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your positions, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

In countries with significant crypto activity, are anti-money laundering rules just words on paper? FATF has decided to take a closer look.

October 30 (Paris) — The Financial Action Task Force announced that, in addition to its regular mutual evaluations, it will launch a targeted review of how virtual asset/VASP standards are being implemented. The focus will be on jurisdictions where “virtual asset service provider activity is materially significant,” selected in light of their current evaluation status. The jurisdictions under review and their number have not yet been announced.

A few points that directly affect ordinary people 👇
🔹 Timeline: Initial findings are due in June 2027, with further findings in October 2027. After the review, a faster monitoring and reporting mechanism will also follow.
🔹 Background: An FATF update this July showed that about 83% of the jurisdictions surveyed had legislated to implement the Travel Rule. However, among the 91 jurisdictions that had legislated, 55 had yet to take supervisory or enforcement action on the Travel Rule.
🔹 Other pain points include identifying unlicensed crypto businesses, regulating foreign VASPs that serve local customers from overseas, and translating risk assessments into licensing, inspections, and penalties.
🔹 What this means for users: In the short term, it’s unlikely you’ll suddenly be “unable to withdraw.” More likely, compliance requirements at the on-ramps will tighten—account opening, deposits and withdrawals, and the collection of information for large transfers (the Travel Rule) will face stricter rules in compliant jurisdictions. The likelihood of gray-market channels and unlicensed platforms being shut down will rise.

Until the list is revealed, don’t get swept up in rumors that “a certain country is about to ban crypto.” What really matters is whether the exchanges you use have local licenses, whether large withdrawals require you to provide additional sender/recipient information, and whether fiat deposit and withdrawal channels will tighten first.

Are you more worried about opening an account getting harder, or being asked more questions when withdrawing crypto across borders?

10 月 30 日（巴黎），金融行动特别工作组宣布：在常规互评估之外，启动针对虚拟资产 / VASP 标准落实情况的专项审查，重点放在「虚拟资产服务提供商活动具有实质重要性」的辖区，并结合其现有评估状态筛选。被审查名单和数量暂未公布。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇
🔹 时间表：首批结果定于 2027 年 6 月公布，后续结果 2027 年 10 月；审查后还会跟更快的监测与报告机制。
🔹 背景：FATF 今年 7 月更新显示，接受调查的辖区里约 83% 已立法落实旅行规则，但在 91 个已立法辖区中，仍有 55 个尚未就旅行规则采取监督或执法行动。
🔹 痛点还包括：识别无牌加密业务、监管从境外服务本地客户的海外 VASP，以及把风险评估真正落到牌照、检查、处罚上。
🔹 对用户意味着什么：短期不是突然「不能提」，更可能是入口合规变严——开户、出入金、大额转账信息采集（旅行规则）在合规辖区会更硬；灰色通道、无牌平台被清扫的概率上升。

名单还没亮牌之前，别被「某国马上封杀」传言带节奏。真正要盯的是：你常用的交易所有没有当地牌照、大额提现要不要补发送方/接收方信息、法币出入金通道会不会先收紧。

你更担心开户变难，还是跨境提币被多问几句？

#FATF启动加密中心反洗钱审查 #BTC #ETH

📰 Why is Ripple’s stablecoin vying to handle aid funds?

Ripple and Water.org announced an expansion of their use of the RLUSD stablecoin and asset custody services, with a focus on testing whether funds can be delivered efficiently to local microfinance institutions. At its core, this partnership explores how effectively digital currencies can be put to work in crisis relief—and could influence how people assess the XRP ecosystem and the prospects for stablecoin applications.

Why does this news matter?
This is another attempt to move digital currencies from “proof of concept” to real-world use. In traditional aid processes, funds are often held back by exchange-rate volatility, cross-border restrictions, or losses at intermediary stages. Ripple aims to use the XRP payment network and RLUSD, which is pegged to the US dollar, to bypass the traditional banking system and distribute funds digitally straight to the places that need them most. This raises the question of whether digital assets can truly serve as a “store of social value,” rather than merely as speculative tools. If the trial succeeds, it could significantly strengthen the narrative around XRP in BaaS (Banking as a Service) use cases.

Market impact
In the short term, the positive impact is concentrated in narratives related to the XRP ecosystem, while recognition of stablecoin use cases may increase. More importantly, however, this validates the potential for digital currencies to address global social issues and could prompt more institutional investors to pay attention to Ripple’s compliant solutions. Compared with the current weakness in BTC and ETH, the positive significance of this news is that it offers the digital asset industry a reflection of its “social value,” rather than serving solely as a financial tool. For historical context, consider the 2014 cross-border payment pilot that JPMorgan and Ripple conducted for the Mexican government, which also sparked market debate about XRP’s value.

Trading approach
This news is more significant for reassessing the value of the XRP ecosystem and could boost sentiment around related tokens in the short term. If testing of RLUSD makes a breakthrough, it will directly validate the feasibility of digital currencies in inclusive finance. However, the process still needs to overcome regulatory compliance and practical implementation hurdles. This thesis would be invalidated if the trial faces widespread rejection in developing countries. 📰 We just said Tether holding BTC was standard practice, and now its CEO drops a bombshell: holdings have doubled. What’s behind it?

Tether CEO Zhao Qianren just announced that the company holds around 150,000 BTC. That’s equivalent to Tether quietly backing every dollar it issues with 0.06 bitcoin in reserves. The source is Crypto Briefing. This isn’t an unexpected development, but the figure is far higher than what had generally been speculated, suddenly putting the symbiotic relationship between stablecoins and Bitcoin front and center.

Why does this news matter?
The root of the issue is that Tether, the world’s largest stablecoin, has long kept the details of its reserves under wraps. Now, by suddenly disclosing the figure, it is effectively acknowledging that Bitcoin is part of its reserves—and recognizing an alternative value-transfer channel beyond stablecoins and fiat currencies. This means:
- Stablecoins are no longer just shadows of fiat currencies; they’re becoming the “Swiss banks” of digital assets.
- Through Tether, Bitcoin has gained a new source of liquidity backing, bypassing traditional banks.
- Regulators suddenly have a new blind spot: if Tether’s BTC reserves change abruptly, how can the flow of funds be traced?

Market impact
In the short term, this news has no direct impact on sentiment toward BTC or ETH, but its long-term implications are significant:
- A 0.5% increase in BTC holdings is just a numbers game; what really changes is how the market sees things.
- Stablecoin holders now have more options. If Tether’s BTC holdings continue to grow as a share of its reserves, some ETH funds could be redirected.
- Regulators may start paying attention to the new concept of “stablecoin-linked assets,” and could eventually require greater transparency around Tether’s BTC holdings.

Trading outlook
This news is neutral in itself, with no clear bullish or bearish bias. But one thing worth watching is that if Tether starts reducing its BTC holdings under pressure, it could trigger a chain reaction. BTC’s current price of $77,218 is one of the support levels for an entity of Tether’s size. If Tether is forced to disclose more reserve details in the future due to regulatory issues, the market may scrutinize this figure repeatedly.

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因在于Tether作为全球最大稳定币，过去总把储备细节藏着掖着。现在突然公布数字，等于默认比特币是其储备的一部分，承认了稳定币和法币之外的另一条价值转移链。这意味着：
- 稳定币不再只是法币的影子，而是变成了数字资产的"瑞士银行"
- 比特币通过Tether这个渠道，获得了新的流动性背书，绕开了传统银行
- 监管层突然多了一个监管盲区：如果Tether的BTC储备突然变化，如何追溯资金流向？

对市场的影响
短期看，这个消息对BTC和ETH的情绪没有直接冲击，但长期影响巨大：
- BTC持仓量增加0.5%只是数字游戏，真正改变的是市场认知
- 稳定币持有者现在有了更多选择，如果未来Tether的BTC持仓占比持续上升，可能会分流一部分ETH资金

操作思路
这个消息本身是中性信息，没有明显的多空倾向。但值得关注的点在于：如果未来Tether因为压力开始减少BTC持仓，可能会引发连锁反应。目前$77,218的BTC价格是Tether这个体量的支撑位之一，如果未来Tether因为监管问题被迫披露更多储备细节，这个数字可能会被市场反复咀嚼。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn't admitting you're wrong; it's a ticket you buy for the next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to set a stop-loss because they treat it as proof that “I'm wrong,” and their pride
can't get past it. Reframe it: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance; the premium is that small loss.
The difference between professional traders and gamblers isn't who's more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I've ever seen cuts his losses more decisively than anyone when he's wrong. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles when placing a stop-loss, tell yourself
one thing: This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

📰 Just as we were talking about Binance losses, Ripple wallets surged by 8,000: Why go against the trend amid regulatory turmoil?

Just a couple of days ago, we analyzed the impact of the Binance hack on the broader crypto market, especially XRP, whose price and sentiment took a serious hit. Then Santiment data suddenly revealed today that nearly 8,000 new XRP wallets were created during this period. That’s the highest figure so far this year, sharply contrasting with the market’s bearish sentiment. It seems many investors don’t care about the price drop and are instead quietly embracing XRP.

Why does this news matter?
This wallet growth is tied to several deeper factors. First, the Binance incident did expose the risks of centralized exchanges, prompting some users to consider self-custody of their assets. As a Layer 1, XRP has long championed decentralization, and this incident provided an opportunity to promote that idea. Second, Ripple has long been navigating regulatory challenges, but compared with other cryptocurrencies, its narrative is more focused on being a “payment tool,” unlike the role of a comprehensive exchange like Binance. So the impact of this crisis may have varied across the market. What does this mean? It shows that even during a broader market downturn, assets with specific use cases can see structural rallies.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this looks more like a contrarian move driven by sentiment. While everyone else is fearful and selling, some are using their wallet activity to express confidence in XRP. This may be because they believe the Binance crisis will have limited long-term effects on XRP, or because they’re waiting for a lower price. In the medium to long term, however, if this trend toward self-custody continues, it could fuel expectations of faster decentralization across the industry. Historically, similar events—such as the exchange hacks in 2017—were indeed followed by a wave of users switching to hardware wallets.

Trading strategy
At present, although the surge in new XRP wallets is a bright spot, its price performance has yet to catch up. This may mean the market is still taking a wait-and-see approach to this activity in the short term. I tend to think that this increase in wallets may translate into a genuine demand signal only if XRP can stabilize above $1.30. If Binance’s reported losses grow further, or regulators’ stance toward the crypto industry as a whole continues to worsen, the rationale behind this wallet growth could easily fall apart.

📰 刚说币安损失，Ripple Wallet 突增8千：监管风波下为啥反向操作？

前两天刚分析过币安遭黑客攻击后，整个加密市场尤其是XRP受的冲击，价格和情绪都跌得有点惨。结果 Santiment 数据今天突然爆出：就在这段时间，XRP 新钱包创造了近8000个。这个数字创下了今年来的新高，跟市场的悲观情绪形成鲜明对比，看起来很多投资者不在乎价格跌，反而开始悄悄地接受XRP。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次钱包增长跟几个深层因素有关。首先，币安事件确实暴露了中心化交易所的风险，让一部分用户开始思考资产自托管的可能性。XRP 本身作为 Layer 1，一直鼓吹去中心化，这次正好借机推广了这个概念。其次，Ripple 之前一直在和监管周旋，但相比其他加密货币，它的叙事更偏向“支付工具”，跟币安这种综合交易所的角色不同，所以在这次危机中受的冲击可能相对分化。这意味着什么？说明即使在整体市场调整期，有特定需求的资产也会出现结构性行情。

对市场的影响
从短期看，这更像是一种情绪上的反向操作。当大家都在恐惧、抛售时，有人选择用钱包行为表达对 XRP 的信心。这可能是因为他们认为币安的危机对 XRP 的长期影响有限，或者是在等更低的价格。但中长期来看，如果这种自托管趋势持续，可能会给整个行业带来去中心化加速的预期。历史上类似事件，比如2017年交易所黑客事件后，也确实出现过用户转向硬件钱包的浪潮。

操作思路
目前来看，虽然 XRP 新钱包激增是个亮点，但价格表现还跟不上。这可能意味着短期内市场对这种行为还是持观望态度。我倾向于认为，除非 XRP 价格能企稳在 $1.30 以上，这种钱包增长才可能转化为真正的需求信号。如果接下来币安的损失数字再扩大，或者监管对整个加密行业的态度继续恶化，这个钱包增长的逻辑就很容易被打破。

Devcon 8 opens in Mumbai today | A conference is not a mainnet upgrade | ETH near $2,255—I’m waiting for now

My stance is to observe, not to add to my position ahead of a conference on the calendar. The Ethereum Foundation and the official Devcon website have both confirmed that Devcon 8 will be held in Mumbai, India, from November 3 to 6. The official agenda lists the opening ceremony for today, from 9:30 a.m. to noon local time. At the time of writing, the ceremony had not yet started, so any claim that something “was announced at the event” should wait for the original statement from the organizers or project team—not a secondhand screenshot. ETH is gaining traction among Binance Square’s most-searched topics over the past six hours, but Devcon isn’t among the exact tags in the top ten trending topics right now, so I won’t force an unrelated tag into the conversation.

Devcon could affect ETH on two time horizons. In the short term, it’s about expectations: developers, infrastructure teams, and application projects are speaking in quick succession, and the market may mistake research directions for catalysts that will deliver results immediately. In the medium term, it’s about verification: whether new technology enters a formal proposal, whether clients are released, whether testnets are completed, and then whether it goes live on mainnet and sees real-world use. The conference itself won’t automatically increase ETH burns, staking yields, or spot buying. It’s especially important to distinguish between “a concept proposed in a talk,” “consensus reached by development teams,” and “mainnet activation.” On October 22, the Foundation still clearly stated that the previously scheduled Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet had been delayed, with no new activation date set. We can’t claim the upgrade has gone live just because Devcon has opened. This also differs from the earlier posts about SAGE: today’s focus is Ethereum’s own developer conference and the process of verifying announcements.

The market hasn’t confirmed a strong move so far. When I checked ETH/USD on Kraken, it was around $2,255, with a 24-hour high of $2,314 and a low of $2,246—closer to the bottom of the range than the top. That’s the observed price level; it can’t be attributed to an opening ceremony that hasn’t started yet. The latest complete U.S. ETH fund data from Farside, for October 30, showed net outflows of $155.7 million. The main products for November 2 were still marked with dashes, and the page’s current total of 0 doesn’t mean institutions definitely had zero creations or redemptions. The Fed held its target interest rate range at 3.75% to 4% on October 28, which also reminds me not to mistake excitement around a conference for a broad easing of liquidity.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t take a directional position right now. I’d wait for a verifiable technical or application announcement after the event, then see whether ETH can hold above $2,280. Only if the original announcement is clear and ETH retests $2,280 without breaking below it would I consider a spot long, with a maximum of 2% of my total capital. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,310, reduce again at the second target of $2,350, and move the stop on the remaining position up based on the intraday low. If ETH falls below $2,235 after entry, I’d exit immediately. If it falls below $2,235 before an entry is triggered, I’d cancel the plan. If the official clarification shows that the supposed major upgrade is only a research discussion, fund outflows worsen, or the price repeatedly fails to stay above $2,280, I’d abandon my bullish scenario and stay out of the market. These are all conditional plans; I’m not assuming I’ve already entered a trade or made a profit.

📰 Why are miners still hoarding coins? Is the volatility myth after Bitcoin announcements true?

Bitcoin prices seem to follow a “pattern”: whenever a major event is announced, the market surges, but then quickly settles down. Bitcoin.com News studied nearly nine years of data and found that most of this volatility is a “false move,” like a bit of psychological massage for the market. According to their analysis, unless you’re watching one-minute candlesticks, there’s no need to worry about announcements.

Why does this news matter?
This study is the first to use data to debunk the myth that “announcements always trigger a major move.” The key findings are: 1) Volatility peaks within an hour of an announcement and has little to do with the actual news; 2) The market quickly returns to near its pre-announcement price. This reflects Bitcoin’s gradually maturing safe-haven qualities—announcements are known variables, while unknown variables (such as large institutional trades) are what investors really need to watch out for. Compared with past regulatory shocks (such as CME’s launch in 2017), the divergence between short-term noise and long-term trends is becoming increasingly clear.

Market impact
This means Bitcoin’s volatility is contracting. For everyday traders, paying too much attention to rumors can lead to a “prediction trap”; for institutional investors, announcement windows have instead become a chance to observe a vacuum in market sentiment. Similar historical events include the period around the FED’s rate hikes in 2021, when Bitcoin surged and then gave back its gains. In hindsight, this kind of “post-announcement pullback” may become the norm.

Trading approach
At the current BTC price of $77,924.21, the post-announcement pullback looks more like an emotional release than a trend reversal. If more announcements emerge in the future but the market remains unmoved, that would instead suggest Bitcoin is becoming more resilient to disruptions. But this view has a caveat: if a regulatory black swan event occurs one day (such as China’s complete crackdown), the impact of announcements could suddenly intensify.

📰 Why is Strategy moving away from BTC and equity?

Michael Saylor’s new take: Strategy can survive without BTC or equity. It’s shifting to digital credit, with less equity dilution but greater liabilities. This shift affects shareholders and market sentiment. According to CryptoBriefing.

Why does this news matter?
The key point is that Strategy is no longer relying on crypto market swings to make a living. A digital credit business is like a traditional financial institution: it has lending obligations, but doesn’t need to burn tokens or issue shares to raise money. This means it’s playing a more mature, but more complex, game.

Looking at the industry cycle, crypto ETFs still haven’t launched, and the battle for BTC dominance is ongoing. Institutional investors are looking for safer avenues. Strategy’s move is like waiting for the tide to recede before coming ashore, but digital credit carries very different risks—it’s not about token prices, but default rates.

How does this relate to other recent events? For example, after the Fed raised interest rates, institutional investment funds began pulling out of high-risk assets. This shift makes a model like Strategy’s more appealing. After all, they use crypto assets as collateral, but the underlying business is no different from real estate lending.

Market impact
The impact on BTC/ETH prices is limited. Strategy’s performance won’t directly send BTC down 10%. But it could affect how the market views “crypto banks.” If the credit business blows up, people will ask: Can crypto businesses still be considered financial services?

Regulators will pay closer attention to this type of model. They used to regulate fundraising by crypto projects; now they’ll be regulating lending. If Strategy runs into trouble lending against crypto assets, regulators will ask: Why use such volatile assets as collateral? In terms of capital flows, it may become harder for crypto projects to raise funds in the future, because banks may be reluctant to get involved.

A historical comparison? Before the 2008 financial crisis, subprime lending worked in a similar way. We all know how that turned out.

Trading perspective
This news points to a new trend in the crypto industry: business diversification. But crypto lending models are extremely risky. If default rates are high, valuations across the entire sector will be affected. If Strategy manages to make this work, it could steer the whole industry toward a more prudent approach.

If regulations tighten in the future, crypto credit businesses may be the first to suffer. This model is more like a crypto version of traditional finance. If regulators decide it should be treated like banking, that won’t be good for the crypto industry as a whole.

和近期其他事件关联？比如美联储加息后，机构理财资金开始撤离高风险资产，这种转向让 Strategy 这种模式更香。毕竟他们用加密资产做抵押，但本质业务和房地产贷款没区别。

OneKey’s founder suddenly spoke out, saying that an especially nasty vulnerability in older iPhone chips can’t be fixed. This is directly related to crypto asset security, since so many people use mobile wallets these days. Put simply, the money on your phone could face a new risk, raising a warning sign for crypto users’ trust.

Why does this news matter?
This isn’t the kind of issue that can be fixed with a quick patch; it’s a fundamental hardware flaw. Just think about how widespread mobile wallets are now. Many people rely on mobile apps to transfer coins, especially smaller-cap tokens. If even the phone’s layer of protection can be breached, doesn’t that make users sitting ducks? More importantly, this ties directly into the controversy over Apple’s “closed ecosystem”—the longer a device is used, the greater the risk. Crypto users are already especially sensitive about security. Finding out that even the devices they’re used to could have a backdoor is bound to be a major shock.

Impact on the market
This news may not directly send Bitcoin or Ethereum plunging, but the impact on sentiment is undeniable. Crypto users may suddenly panic and move their assets into hardware wallets, shifting the ecosystem’s funds from software to hardware. Most importantly, this could prompt regulators to pay even more attention to digital asset security. Regulators are constantly talking about strengthening protections, and now Apple’s own devices have issues—regulatory pressure could once again spill over into the crypto world. Have there been similar events in the past? Before the 2008 financial crisis, people didn’t fully understand the risks of derivatives, and regulators eventually stepped in to impose rules. This could be a similar situation, except that the source of the risk has shifted to consumer electronics hardware.

How to approach it
This news suggests that demand for hardware wallets will grow exponentially in the future, especially for cold-storage solutions. 📰 Why Has Australia’s Property Market Crashed, Yet Nobody Is Buying? Where Are the Policy and Regulatory Floors?

Melbourne, Australia, saw its auction clearance rate hit a six-year low due to a public holiday and market concerns that interest rates will continue to rise. This is not simply seasonal weakness; it reflects residents’ fears of rising interest rates and pressure for a possible policy shift. For crypto markets, this means global risk appetite may remain under pressure.

Why does this news matter?
The key concern behind the drop in the auction clearance rate is the possibility of a “policy floor.” The Reserve Bank of Australia is raising interest rates to fight inflation, but the market fears this could weigh on the economy and lead to higher unemployment. This uncertainty is making homebuyers more cautious. For crypto markets, it means risk appetite may remain under pressure, as major economies around the world are going through tightening cycles, diverting some investment capital. In addition, if Australia’s property market continues to weaken, it could prompt further policy stimulus, which is often favorable for crypto markets. But Australia’s situation is more complex: its tightening is intended to prevent the economy from overheating, whereas many countries are providing stimulus to prevent an economic downturn.

Market impact
In the short term, this event could heighten concerns about rising interest rates and weigh on sentiment toward BTC and ETH. In the medium to long term, however, if the Reserve Bank of Australia is eventually forced to slow the pace of rate hikes or even pivot to easing, this would support global risk assets. Historical data shows that cryptocurrencies often perform well when major economies pivot to easing. For now, Australia’s situation looks more like a brief episode within the global tightening cycle than a turning point. If similar signs of weakness emerge in more economies, this could trigger a shift in global central bank policy, which would be a major positive for crypto markets.

Trading approach
For now, this event’s impact on crypto markets is mostly sentiment-driven and will not change the long-term trend. BTC and ETH support levels remain solid, and the fundamentals are unchanged as long as no systemic risk event occurs. However, it is worth watching whether continued weakness in Australia’s property market prompts further policy stimulus. Such stimulus often leads to a short-lived rally in crypto markets rather than signaling a reversal. If similar signs of weakness emerge in more economies, this could trigger a shift in global central bank policy—and that would be the real opportunity.

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次拍卖率下滑的关键在于"政策底"的隐忧。澳洲央行正在加息对抗通胀，但市场担心这会拖累经济，导致失业率上升。这种不确定性让购房决策变得更加谨慎。对加密市场来说，意味着风险偏好可能继续承压，因为全球主要经济体都在经历紧缩周期，这会分流一部分投资资金。此外，如果澳洲地产持续疲软，可能会引发更多政策刺激，这种政策刺激对加密市场往往是利好的，但澳洲的情况更复杂——因为他们的紧缩是为了防止经济过热，而很多国家的刺激是为了防止经济衰退。

对市场的影响
短期来看，这个事件可能会加剧市场对利率上升的担忧，对BTC和ETH的情绪面造成压力。但从中长期看，如果澳洲央行最终被迫放缓加息步伐，甚至转向宽松，这会为全球风险资产提供支撑。历史数据显示，当主要经济体转向宽松时，加密货币往往会有不错的表现。目前来看，澳洲的情况更像是全球紧缩周期中的一个插曲，而不是转折点。如果未来更多经济体出现类似疲软迹象，可能会引发全球央行政策的转向，这对加密市场将是重大利好。

操作思路
目前这个事件对加密市场的影响更多是情绪层面，不会改变长期趋势。BTC和ETH的支撑位依然稳固，只要没有出现系统性风险事件，基本面没有改变。但需要关注的是，如果澳洲地产继续疲软，可能会引发更多政策刺激，这种刺激对加密市场往往是短期的脉冲行情，而不是反转信号。如果未来更多经济体出现类似疲软迹象，可能会引发全球央行政策的转向，这时候才是真正的机会。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold—or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “compounding positions” has been all the rage lately. The stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound your position a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What compounding positions involves】Instead of cashing out floating profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep trading,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is astonishing; when it stops, those floating profits
can go from dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two steep down days.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If you have a 60% win rate each time, the chance of getting it right four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

translatedData.title: Scaling out of a trade: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out strategy I've been using.

【Three steps】Part one: When the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), sell a third to lock in some gains,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset changes instantly. Part two: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another third. Part three: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop; if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, exit and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Exit the whole position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you'll often watch it ride the elevator back down to where you started.

Palantir claims that its fine-tuned 4B-parameter Nvidia model outperformed larger AI rivals at a lower cost. This suggests that smaller models may be more practical than massive models for specific tasks, potentially upending the AI industry's conventional wisdom that "bigger is better." For the cryptocurrency market, which depends on AI computing power, this could mean increased cost pressure, particularly for AI-related stocks.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying reason is that the AI industry is shifting from pursuing scale in model parameters to prioritizing cost-effectiveness. Over the past few years, the AI race has become an arms race of piling on parameters, but computing resources are expensive. The emergence of smaller, more specialized models could significantly reduce the cost of deploying AI. For the cryptocurrency market, this means more industries may be able to afford AI solutions, potentially driving demand indirectly.

This is related to the recent trend of AI shifting from hype to practicality. The market was previously swept up in excitement over massive models like ChatGPT, but their real-world applications are extremely costly. Palantir's breakthrough suggests that AI is returning to its core purpose of "solving problems," which is good news for industries such as finance and healthcare that need to put AI solutions into practice quickly. In the cryptocurrency market, DeFi protocols and NFT platforms could become more attractive to the digital asset ecosystem if they can use low-cost AI to improve efficiency.

Market impact
In the short term, this news could boost interest in AI-related stocks (such as NVDA), since it means a wider market can access AI technology. Over the long term, if smaller models really do lower the barrier to adopting AI, they could accelerate its adoption across industries, including quantitative trading and smart contract optimization in the cryptocurrency sector. In theory, lower AI costs would benefit the entire digital economy, but the specific channels through which this might happen remain unclear.

The current market backdrop shows BTC and ETH both undergoing slight pullbacks, possibly reflecting investor concerns about macroeconomic risks, such as Federal Reserve policy. The positive effects of lower AI costs could be offset by negative factors such as inflation data and geopolitical tensions. If lower AI costs drive real demand growth in an industry such as DeFi, they could support cryptocurrency prices. But without a clear transmission path, this news may have a limited direct impact on BTC/ETH.

Trading approach
This news suggests that the AI industry may be entering an era of cost-effectiveness, which could indirectly benefit the cryptocurrency market, given its reliance on computing power. BTC and ETH prices are currently near key support levels from earlier periods. If lower AI costs drive growth in real-world applications, they could support these major cryptocurrencies in the short term. However, it's important to watch for concrete implementation examples; otherwise, the potential benefits may not materialize. 📰 Is the quantum computer threat smaller than AI’s? Swan founder says Bitcoin’s security alert level has been raised

The founder of Swan Bitcoin recently issued a warning on CoinTelegraph: hackers can now easily use large language models (LLMs) to find vulnerabilities in Bitcoin’s security, making this type of attack more frightening than people imagine. This means that, in addition to traditional technical challenges, Bitcoin must also defend against increasingly sophisticated AI attacks.

Why does this news matter?
The key issue is the cost and efficiency of LLM attacks. In the past, hackers needed programming skills to exploit security vulnerabilities. Now, all they need to do is ask AI a few questions. This is like suddenly raising the knowledge level of the entire hacking community by several orders of magnitude, while the security defenses of an established digital asset like Bitcoin have yet to catch up. Why does this matter? It means Bitcoin’s security battle is entering a new phase—not just a technical contest, but a test of intelligence. This differs from the threat quantum computers pose to Bitcoin: the latter is a future risk, while LLM attacks are immediate and foreseeable. Put simply, Bitcoin’s defenses have suddenly discovered that the enemy can do more than kick down the door—they can also pick the lock in smarter ways.

Impact on the market
From a market perspective, this won’t directly cause Bitcoin’s price to plunge, but it will heighten investor concerns about “digital asset security.” BTC and ETH have both been falling recently, and these concerns could be the last straw. However, Bitcoin’s safe-haven appeal as “digital gold” won’t disappear because of this, though the risk of AI attacks could mean greater price volatility. A similar historical event? In 2007, an AI customer service failure at Bell cental bank led to a large transfer—an early example of AI capabilities getting out of control. Now this risk has shifted to Bitcoin.

Trading approach
Based on the Swan founder’s warning, Bitcoin’s current security defenses may indeed have weaknesses. This means that if large-scale AI-driven attacks occur, Bitcoin’s price could come under short-term pressure. But as the most mature and secure cryptocurrency, Bitcoin’s underlying value won’t be completely undermined by technological threats. If hackers really do exploit LLMs on a large scale, there could be a more pronounced negative reaction in the short term.

Swan Bitcoin的创始人最近在CoinTelegraph上发布警告：现在黑客利用大型语言模型（LLM）就能轻易找到比特币安全的漏洞，这种攻击方式比想象中更可怕。这意味着，除了传统技术挑战，比特币还得防着越来越智能的AI攻击了。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条消息的关键在于LLM攻击的成本和效率。过去，黑客需要懂编程才能利用安全漏洞，现在只需要会写几个问题给AI。这相当于让整个黑客界的知识水平突然提升了几个数量级，而比特币这种老牌数字资产的安全防护还没跟上。为什么重要？意味着比特币的攻防战进入了新阶段——不仅是技术对抗，更是对抗聪明度的较量。这跟量子计算机威胁比特币的情况不同，后者是未来隐患，LLM攻击是即时的、可预见的。简单说：比特币的安全防线突然发现，敌人不仅会踢门，还会用更聪明的手段撬锁。

对市场的影响
从市场角度看，这不会直接导致比特币价格暴跌，但会加剧投资者对"数字资产安全"的担忧。BTC和ETH最近都在下跌，这种风险担忧可能会成为压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。不过，比特币作为"数字黄金"的避险属性不会因此消失，但AI攻击的风险意味着它的价格波动性可能加大。历史上类似事件？2007年贝尔 cental银行的AI客服失误导致大额转账，就是AI能力失控的早期案例，现在这个风险转移到了比特币。

操作思路
从Swan创始人的警告来看，当前比特币的安全防护可能确实存在短板。这意味着如果出现大规模AI驱动的攻击，比特币价格可能会有短期承压表现。但比特币作为最成熟和安全的加密货币，其价值基础不会因为技术威胁而完全瓦解。如果黑客真的大规模利用LLM攻击，可能会在短期内有更明显的负面反应。

SEC Adds Governance Q&A｜ETH Trades Sideways Around $2,253｜Regulatory Guidance Cannot Replace Project Facts

My position is to remain on the sidelines, especially rather than reading regulatory language as immediate approval of ETH or any particular staking product. On November 2, the SEC’s Division of Corporation Finance updated its crypto asset FAQ, adding Questions 1.4 and 1.5, which discuss when “broadly distributed governance participants” might constitute a central party in control of a system, and what constitutes a central party’s “supervisory involvement.” The document says the assessment depends on the specific facts; broadly distributed participants who are not affiliated with one another and have not separately agreed to act in concert generally would not be considered the same central party merely because they participate in governance. On the other hand, a party with unilateral power to control access for protocols, validators, or users, change upgrade-voting procedures, or rewrite rules and revoke access could be considered to have supervisory involvement. The FAQ explicitly states that it reflects only the views of staff, has no legal force, and is not an SEC determination about the ETH network in any specific case.

Why is this worth paying attention to? Ethereum upgrades, validators, and application governance are often grouped under the same “decentralization” label, but regulatory analysis focuses on who actually has the power to control which parts. A community vote does not automatically show that control is not centralized; a foundation’s involvement in research does not prove that it can unilaterally change mainnet rules. For the ETH ecosystem, the protocol change process, client adoption, validator distribution, and actual powers must be verified. This FAQ is an analytical framework, not a blanket green light for all tokens. Product issuance structures and investor rights still need to be assessed separately.

The market has not yet shown a move confirming “regulatory tailwinds.” When I checked, Kraken’s ETH spot price was around $2,253, with a 24-hour low of $2,233.51 and a high of $2,314.32; compared with the previous figure of around $2,251, that is only a slight fluctuation. Farside reported combined net outflows of $155.7 million from ETH funds on October 30; the November 2 figures were still dashes, and the automatic total of 0.0 does not confirm that there was no change in flows. Historical outflows and the current price are not enough to prove that the sideways trading was driven by the SEC FAQ. The latest protocol announcement on the Ethereum Foundation website still says the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed, with a new date to be determined; it would be inaccurate to say that mainnet has already been upgraded.

In the short term, I’m watching the low near $2,233, the $2,250 midpoint as an observation level, and the $2,314 high. If the price regains and holds above $2,280 on the hourly chart, and then holds that level on a retest, that would indicate easing short-term selling pressure; if it breaks below $2,233 and fails to recover on a bounce, the recovery thesis is invalidated. What could genuinely change the broader outlook would be sustained improvement after fund-level figures are released, clear official updates on protocol progress, or new SEC rules formally issued with legal force. If the staff FAQ is revised, the regulatory interpretation must also be revisited; the word “SEC” in a headline is no reason to become more confident.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now, keeping only a conditional spot-long bias and avoiding high leverage. Only if the hourly close breaks above $2,280 and the price holds that level on a retest would I open a trial position using 2% of total capital. I would first take half off at $2,300, then half of the remainder near $2,314, and use the hourly low as a trailing take-profit level for the rest. I would set the initial stop at $2,245 and close the entire position if it is hit; if the price falls back below $2,280 within four hours of entry, I would also close proactively. If $2,233 breaks first, I would cancel the long plan and wait for a new structure and the ETF fund-level figures. The long-term significance of regulatory guidance and today’s trade execution must be assessed separately.

Sources checked: SEC Division of Corporation Finance FAQ, Ethereum Foundation announcements, Farside fund table, Kraken quotes, Binance Square trending page. #ETH

The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.
