SEC新增治理问答｜ETH约2253美元横盘｜监管解释不能代替项目事实

我的态度是保持观望，尤其不把监管文字读成对ETH或某个质押产品的即时批准。美国SEC公司融资部11月2日更新加密资产常见问答，新加入的第1.4和1.5问讨论“广泛治理参与者”何时可能构成控制系统的中心方，以及何谓中心方“监督参与”。文件说判断取决于具体事实；彼此没有关联、也没有另外约定一致行动的广泛参与者，一般不会仅因参与治理就被视为同一个中心方。另一面，若某方有单方权力控制协议、验证者或用户的准入，改变升级投票程序，或改写规则与撤销访问，就可能属于监督参与。问答明示这只是工作人员观点，无法律效力，并非SEC对ETH网络作出的个案认定。

为什么值得看？以太坊升级、验证者和应用治理常被放在同一个“去中心化”标签里，但监管分析关心谁实际有权控制哪些环节。社区投票不自动说明没有集中控制；基金会参与研究，也不证明它能单方面改变主网规则。对ETH生态，须核实协议变更流程、客户端采纳、验证者分布与实际权限。这个问答是分析框架，不是给所有代币统一发通行证。产品发行结构和投资者权利仍须分别看。

市场还没有给出“监管利好确认”的走势。Kraken ETH现货我查看时约2253美元，二十四小时低点2233.51、高点2314.32；与前次约2251美元相比只是小幅波动。Farside 10月30日ETH基金合计净流出1.557亿美元，11月2日分项仍是横杠，自动合计0.0不等于确认没有资金变化。历史流出与当前价格不足以证明震荡由SEC问答推动。以太坊基金会官网最新协议公告仍是Hoodi测试网Glamsterdam延期，新日期待定；不能写成主网已经升级。

短线我盯2233美元附近低点、2250中间观察位和2314高点。若一小时重新站稳2280并回踩不破，说明短线卖压缓和；若跌穿2233且回抽失败，修复判断撤销。真正能改变更大级别判断的，是基金分项公布后持续改善、官方协议进度明确，或SEC正式发布具有法律效力的新规则。工作人员FAQ若被修订，监管解读也必须重做；不因为标题里的“SEC”二字提高确信度。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅保留条件式现货做多，不开高杠杆。只有一小时收盘上破2280美元并回踩守住，才以总资金2%试单；2300美元先减一半，2314美元附近再减剩余的一半，余仓跟随一小时低点止盈。初始止损放在2245美元，触及全部平仓；进场后四小时仍跌回2280下方也主动平仓。若2233先破，取消多头计划，等新结构及ETF分项数据。监管解释的长期意义与今天的交易执行必须分开验证。

核对依据：SEC公司融资部FAQ、Ethereum Foundation公告、Farside基金表、Kraken报价、币安广场热点页。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二日，以太坊现货价格报二千二百四十八美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点六九。价格从二千二百六十九美元附近逐步回落至二千二百四十五美元区域，整体呈现弱势震荡格局。当前价格已经跌破七周期均线二千二百五十九美元和二十五周期均线二千二百七十九美元，同时位于九十九周期均线二千二百五十八美元下方，短期均线系统全面走弱。

从布林带指标来看，价格运行在下轨二千二百四十六美元附近，中轨位于二千二百八十美元，上轨在二千三百一十四美元。价格持续贴近下轨运行，显示空头占据主导地位。抛物线转向指标位于二千二百七十六美元，远高于当前价格，确认了下行趋势的延续。平均真实波幅为十五点五二美元，波动性较前期有所收敛，但方向仍然偏空。

值得注意的是，以太坊的复合指标信号显示为看多， fifteen个因子中有九个发出做多信号，占比百分之六十，这与价格走势形成一定背离，暗示市场内部可能存在分歧，短期内或有技术性修复的机会。

二、技术指标深度解读

从动量指标来看，六周期相对强弱指数从前一时段的十五点八八回升至三十二点七五，十二周期相对强弱指数为三十七点四三，二十四周期相对强弱指数为四十三点八六。短期RSI从极度超卖区域有所反弹，但整体仍处于偏弱水平，说明卖压虽有缓解但尚未完全消退。

移动平均收敛发散指标方面，MACD线为负五点四五，信号线为负零点六二，柱状图为负四点八三。虽然MACD仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图的绝对值较前一小时有所收窄，显示空头动能正在逐步减弱。如果后续柱状图继续收窄并出现金叉迹象，可能预示着短期反弹行情的启动。

KDJ指标中K线为二十三点零七，D线为二十四点四七，J线为二十点二八，三线均处于低位区域但已开始走平，有形成底部金叉的潜力。威廉指标读数为负七十三点二四，较前一小时的负八十三点六五有明显回升，同样暗示超卖状态正在改善。随机相对强弱指数从零点一三大幅回升至六点七五，短期动能有所恢复。

从成交量来看，最近几个小时的交易量从二千五百三十六万美元逐步缩减至六百九十六万美元，缩量特征明显。在下跌末端出现缩量通常意味着卖盘力量接近枯竭，但反转仍需要增量资金的配合。

三、市场情绪与宏观环境分析

以太坊当前面临的市场环境与比特币类似，同样受到ETF资金外流的压制。现货以太坊ETF上周净流出三亿九千六百六十万美元，整个十月份累计流出约十六亿美元，其中贝莱德的ETHA基金领跌。机构资金的持续撤离对以太坊的短期走势构成了显著压力。

此外，币安此前遭遇的六十三亿美元黑客攻击事件的余波仍在发酵，部分黑客资金被转换为以太坊进行跨链转移，引发了资产冻结和黑名单风险的担忧。这对以太坊的网络声誉和投资者信心产生了负面影响。

不过也有积极因素值得关注。Bitmine公司将以太坊持仓增加至六百零六万枚ETH，显示机构对以太坊长期价值的认可。同时，以太坊当前的极度超卖状态在历史上往往对应着阶段性底部的形成，技术性反弹的概率正在积累。

综合来看，以太坊短期仍处于弱势格局，但多项技术指标显示超卖程度已经非常严重，反弹条件正在逐步酝酿。投资者可关注二千二百四十美元至二千二百五十美元区间的支撑有效性，若价格能够企稳并放量突破二千二百八十美元的中轨位置，短期反弹行情有望展开。建议耐心等待明确信号，不宜盲目抄底。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we’ll look at how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

[State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive] This means longs are overcrowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. This doesn’t mean you should immediately
shorting, but rather: be extra cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates remain negative] Shorts are overcrowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out already has, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in history have started at times like these.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What is the funding rate? Why do longs have to pay shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
One term you can't avoid when trading perpetual contracts is the funding rate. It is settled every 8 hours, and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay each other. The exchange only collects and pays it out; it doesn't make money from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

This is another follow-up on Mercado Bitcoin, filling in the gap left in the previous post—not a new event, but a substantial upward revision to the frozen-asset tally.

In the previous post (03:38), we wrote that Bitquery had tallied $7.3M frozen, and that Circle had just followed up by freezing about $708,000 in USDC, bringing the list of entities doing the freezing to three: Tether, Paxos, and Circle.

In this round of research, the first figures I found from two independent trackers both put the total frozen amount at around $9.2M:

Researcher Specter’s breakdown comes to $9,169,052.38: about $3.76M in USDT, $2.96M in USDC, $1.45M in PAXG, $444,000 in USDT0, and $317,000 in XAUt, with the remainder in smaller amounts of AUSD, USAT, RLUSD, USDP, and others. Another on-chain tracker, OnchainLens, puts the figure at $9.27M across 5 addresses. The two figures differ by less than $100,000, putting them in the same ballpark—and they aren’t just two versions of the same source.

The biggest change is in USDC: in the previous post, Circle had only confirmed freezing about $708,000, while the USDC total in this breakdown is now around $2.96M. In other words, freezing continued after Circle’s move—but note that both figures are marked as tallies from November 2. I couldn’t find the exact publication time for Specter’s breakdown, so I won’t present this as something that just happened at 04:38. It’s an upward revision to the tally uncovered for the first time in this round of research; from now on, the previous post’s $7.3M figure is out of date.

Let’s do the math: using Bitquery’s rough total of $48.5M, $9.2M is about 19%, compared with around 15% for the $7.3M figure in the previous post. The frozen share has climbed from 15% to nearly 20%, but 80% of the assets are still out there. Freezing doesn’t mean recovery, and it certainly doesn’t mean deposits and withdrawals have resumed—Mercado’s deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, and the exchange still hasn’t provided a resumption timeline, confirmed the total, or explained the root cause.

Current prices (cross-checked against two sources at 04:40): $BTC  approximately 76873, down about 1.29% over 24h; $ETH  approximately 2247, down about 0.73%; $SOL  approximately 91.15, down about 3.34%. This pullback is ordinary market fluctuation; I won’t force a connection to the Mercado situation.

My take: the rising frozen-asset tally is good news, but don’t let “another batch frozen” distract from what matters. Only two things can really change the situation: when deposits and withdrawals resume, and when the exchange itself confirms the losses. Until then, every increase in the frozen total is just progress in blocking assets—not a resolution.

Risk note: All figures above are from on-chain trackers, not an official loss assessment by the exchange. I haven’t found any information on whether the frozen assets will be returned or what process would be involved. This is not investment advice.

变化最大的是 USDC：上一帖 Circle 只确认冻了约 $70.8 万，这份明细里的 USDC 已经到了约 $296 万。也就是说 Circle 那一笔之后，冻结又往前走了一截——但注意，这两份口径都标注为 11 月 2 日的盘点，我没拿到 Specter 这份明细的精确发布时间，所以这篇不冒充是 04:38 当刻刚发生的事，它是本轮首次核到的账本上调，上一帖的 $7.3M 说法从这一轮起过期。

算一笔账：按 Bitquery 的 $48.5M 总盘粗算，$9.2M 大约是 19%，上一帖的 $7.3M 是约 15%。冻结比例从一成半爬到了将近两成，但八成资产仍在外面。冻结也不等于追回，更不等于充提恢复——Mercado 的充提仍暂停，交易所至今没给恢复时间表、没确认总数、没给根因。

现价（04:40 双信源核过）：$BTC 约 76873，24h 跌约 1.29%；$ETH 约 2247，跌约 0.73%；$SOL 约 91.15，跌约 3.34%。这波回落是普通波动，我不硬把它归因到 Mercado 这一件事上。

我的看法：冻结账本爬坡是好事，但别被“又冻了一笔”带偏节奏——真正能改变局面的只有两件事，一是充提什么时候恢复，二是交易所什么时候亲口定损。在那之前，冻结数每涨一截，都只算拦截进度，不算结案。

风险提示：以上数字均为链上追踪方口径，非交易所官方定损；冻结资产能否归还、走什么程序，目前均未查到，不构成任何操作建议。

你们怎么看？冻结比例爬到两成，算不算这件事开始收口了，还是说只要充提一天不开，就一天不算完？

November 2, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of November 3, Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,242, down slightly by 0.23% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly candlestick chart, ETH fell and then stabilized over the past five hours, gradually retreating from $2,273 to around $2,254. It touched a low of $2,237 before edging back up to $2,255.

In terms of moving averages, Ethereum has fallen below the support of all short- and medium-term moving averages. The 7-period moving average is at $2,265, the 25-period moving average at $2,279, and the 99-period moving average at $2,259. The current price is below all of them, forming a clear bearish alignment. The EMA indicators are also weakening: the 7-period EMA is at $2,264, the 25-period EMA at $2,274, and the 99-period EMA at $2,277. The gap between the price and the moving averages is widening.

The Bollinger Bands show a lower band at $2,251, a middle band at $2,282, and an upper band at $2,313. The current price has fallen below the lower band, signaling extreme short-term weakness. However, the lower Bollinger Band is often a trigger zone for short-term rebounds, so it is worth watching whether the price can find firm support here.

Trading volume has gradually dwindled over the past few hours, with turnover falling from 25.36 million USDT to 3.99 million USDT. This decline suggests selling pressure has eased somewhat at current price levels, but buyers are also not very active, leaving the market in a standoff between bulls and bears.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

Ethereum’s momentum indicators also show oversold conditions. The 6-period RSI is 23.63, the 12-period RSI is 34.94, and the 24-period RSI is 43.35. The short-term RSI has entered oversold territory, though it has not reached the extreme levels seen in Bitcoin, indicating that ETH’s oversold conditions are relatively moderate.

For the MACD, the MACD line is -4.17, the signal line is 0.70, and the histogram is -4.87. The MACD has crossed below the signal line, forming a bearish crossover, while the histogram has remained negative, indicating continued release of bearish momentum. However, the histogram’s absolute value narrowed from -5.02 in the previous hour to -4.87, showing faint signs that bearish pressure is easing.

The KDJ indicator shows a K value of 24.89, a D value of 26.38, and a J value of 21.91. All three lines are in low territory, but the J line has begun to turn upward, which may signal short-term rebound momentum. The Williams %R (WR) reading is -72.66. Although it remains in weak territory, it has recovered from -75.06 in the previous hour.

Quantitative factor statistics show that 8 of 15 factors signal a long position, while 7 signal a short position. The balance between bullish and bearish signals is fairly close, with long factors accounting for 53.3%. The composite indicator signals a short position, with a short signal win rate of 84.21% and an overall win rate of 72.34%. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s bearish signals are more consistent, and their win rate is also higher, suggesting that short signals have historically been more reliable.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The biggest pressure currently facing the Ethereum market comes from ETF outflows. Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of $396.6 million last week, while BlackRock’s ETHA fund alone saw approximately $1.32 billion flow out in October. The continued withdrawal of institutional funds over several months has put clear downward pressure on Ethereum’s price.

However, there are also positive developments in the fundamentals. Bitmine added 8,573 ETH to its treasury reserves, bringing its total holdings to approximately 6.06 million ETH, or 4.96% of the circulating supply. Continued corporate accumulation is providing some support for Ethereum’s price floor. Meanwhile, the shrinking validator exit queue indicates that pressure from staking withdrawals is easing, which should help stabilize the price base.

On-chain, the laundering of stolen funds through the Ethereum network has drawn regulatory attention. This could bring the risk of address-level regulatory freezes, adding further pressure to market sentiment. Losses in the cryptocurrency industry from hacking incidents have reached $8.74 billion in 2026, more than three times the $2.51 billion recorded in 2025. The ongoing security concerns are also weighing on investor confidence.

In the short term, Ethereum has technical support in the $2,237–$2,251 range. If it holds this zone and rebounds on rising trading volume, it could challenge the Bollinger Band middle line near $2,280. But if it falls below $2,237, it may drop further toward the key $2,200 level.

以太坊市场深度分析：ETF流出拖累价格，超卖中寻找支撑

2026年11月2日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间11月3日凌晨，以太坊报价2242美元，过去24小时微跌0.23%。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去5个小时内经历了先跌后企稳的过程，从2273美元逐步回落至2254美元附近，最低触及2237美元，随后小幅回升至2255美元。

均线系统方面，以太坊已经跌破了所有短中期均线的支撑。7周期均线位于2265美元，25周期均线位于2279美元，99周期均线位于2259美元，当前价格运行在所有均线下方，呈现明显的空头排列格局。EMA指标同样走弱，7周期EMA为2264美元，25周期EMA为2274美元，99周期EMA为2277美元，价格与均线之间的偏离度正在扩大。

布林带指标显示，下轨位于2251美元，中轨位于2282美元，上轨位于2313美元。当前价格已经跌破布林带下轨，这是短期极端弱势的信号。不过布林带下轨往往也是短线反弹的触发区域，需要关注价格能否在此位置获得有效支撑。

成交量方面，过去几个小时的成交额从2536万USDT逐步萎缩至399万USDT，呈现递减趋势。成交量的萎缩说明在当前价位卖盘力量有所减弱，但买盘同样不够积极，市场处于多空僵持状态。

二、技术指标解读

以太坊的动量指标同样显示超卖状态。6周期RSI为23.63，12周期RSI为34.94，24周期RSI为43.35。短期RSI已经进入超卖区域，但尚未达到比特币那样的极端水平，说明ETH的超卖程度相对温和一些。

MACD指标方面，MACD线为负4.17，信号线为0.70，柱状图为负4.87。MACD已经下穿信号线形成死叉，柱状图连续为负，空头动能持续释放。不过柱状图的绝对值从上一小时的负5.02收窄至负4.87，空头力量出现了微弱的衰减迹象。

KDJ指标方面，K值为24.89，D值为26.38，J值为21.91，三线均处于低位区域但J值已开始拐头向上，可能暗示短期存在反弹动能。威廉指标WR读数为负72.66，虽然仍处于偏弱区域但已从前一小时的负75.06有所回升。

量化因子统计显示，15个因子中有8个发出做多信号，7个发出做空信号，多空力量较为接近，做多因子占比53.3%。复合指标信号为做空，做空胜率为84.21%，整体胜率为72.34%。相比比特币，以太坊的空头信号更为一致，但胜率也更高，说明做空信号的历史有效性较强。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临的最大压力来自ETF资金流出。现货以太坊ETF上周录得3.966亿美元的净流出，其中贝莱德的ETHA基金在10月份 alone 就流出了约13.2亿美元。持续数月的机构资金撤离对以太坊价格形成了明显的压制。

不过基本面方面不乏利好。Bitmine公司新增了8573枚ETH进入其国库储备，总持仓达到约606万枚ETH，占流通供应量的4.96%。企业层面的持续增持为以太坊提供了一定的底部支撑。同时，验证者退出队列的缩减表明质押解除压力正在降低，有利于价格基底的稳定。

从链上数据来看，被盗资金通过以太坊网络进行洗钱的操作引发了监管关注，这可能带来地址级别的监管冻结风险，对市场情绪构成额外压力。2026年加密货币行业因黑客攻击造成的损失已达87.4亿美元，是2025年25.1亿美元的三倍以上，安全问题的持续发酵也在影响投资者信心。

短期来看，以太坊在2237至2251美元区间存在技术支撑，若能守住这一区域并出现成交量配合的反弹，则有望向2280美元附近的布林带中轨发起挑战。但若跌破2237美元，则可能进一步下探2200美元整数关口。

【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。

把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant; it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than liquidating the entire position at once.

October nonfarm payrolls not yet released | ETH: watch 2,233 support first | Don’t bet on rate cuts before the data

My stance on ETH is to wait and see; I won’t bet on an incorrect timeline. Binance Square’s trending topic says “#US October nonfarm payrolls released: Is there still a chance of rate cuts?”, but the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ 2026 release calendar clearly states that the October Employment Situation report is scheduled for release at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on November 6. The BLS’s September jobs report also repeats this schedule at the end. It is now early on November 3, Beijing time, and October nonfarm payrolls have not yet been released according to the official schedule. The trending topic’s claim that they are “out” cannot be treated as fact, and neither new job numbers nor an unemployment rate should be made up. The Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) for September will be released on November 3; it is not the same indicator as October nonfarm payrolls.

Why does this matter for ETH? Employment data can affect market estimates of the Federal Reserve’s rate path, and rate expectations in turn affect dollar funding costs, risk-asset valuations, and demand for positions in assets such as ETH. On October 28, the Fed officially decided to maintain its target range at 3.75%–4%; two committee members even preferred a 25-basis-point hike at that meeting. So there’s no basis for declaring “rate cuts are certain” before new data comes out. ETH is also constrained by its own capital flows: Farside’s U.S. ETH funds table shows net outflows of $155.7 million on October 30, while all funds still show dashes for November 2. The automatically calculated total of 0.0 cannot be treated as confirmed zero flows. Yesterday, SEC staff updated its crypto asset FAQ, but that was only an explanation of how assets are classified structurally—not blanket approval for all staking products. Compressing these different pieces of information into a single “ETH bullish” label risks overlooking real risks.

How has the market reacted so far? The latest Kraken ETH/USD trade was around $2,251, with a 24-hour low of $2,233.51 and a high of $2,314.32, below the day’s opening price of about $2,272. My 02:40 post recorded a price of around $2,250; there has been no verified one-way rally since. The previous post’s trading plan also has no record of an execution, so I can’t retrospectively claim I caught the move. $2,233 is the current intraday low, $2,272 is the opening-price level that needs to be reclaimed first, and $2,314 is resistance above. If the price breaks below $2,233 and cannot get back above it within an hour, the short-term support thesis is invalidated. If it reclaims $2,272 and holds, then I can reassess. If the official employment data on November 6 significantly changes rate expectations, or subsequent fund flows confirm a sustained deterioration, today’s range-based view will need to be recalculated. Price moves cannot all be attributed after the fact to nonfarm payrolls that have not yet been released.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t enter right now; I’d only consider a small spot long after confirmation. I’d wait for ETH to move back above $2,275 and hold that level on an hourly retest, then confirm there are no new negative official announcements. Only then would I place a test trade using at most 3% of my total capital, with no leverage. My first target would be $2,315, where I’d sell half; the second target would be $2,350, where I’d reduce the remaining position in stages. I’d set the initial stop-loss at $2,230. If, after entering, the price stayed below $2,260 for an hour, I’d also close the position proactively. If neither level is reached within 24 hours, the plan is void; I’ll make a separate assessment when the November 6 nonfarm payrolls data is released. Waiting for real data matters more than trading ahead of a headline.

#US October nonfarm payrolls released: Is there still a chance of rate cuts? #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我对ETH的态度是先观望，不拿一条错误时间线下注。币安广场热榜写着“#美国10月非农出炉：降息还有戏吗？”，但美国劳工统计局的2026年发布日历明确列出：10月《就业形势》报告计划在美国东部时间11月6日08:30发布。劳工统计局9月就业报告末尾也重复了这个日程。现在是北京时间11月3日凌晨，10月非农尚未按官方计划公布；热榜里的“已出炉”不能当成事实，更不能编造新增就业人数或失业率。11月3日将公布的是9月职位空缺和劳动力流动调查，和10月非农不是同一个指标。

这件事为什么与ETH有关？就业数据会影响市场对美联储利率路径的估计，利率预期又会影响美元融资成本、风险资产估值和ETH等资产的仓位需求。美联储10月28日正式决定维持3.75%—4%的目标区间，两名委员甚至希望当次加息25个基点。因此在新数据出来前直接喊“降息确定”缺乏依据。ETH还受到自身资金面的约束：Farside的美国ETH基金表格显示10月30日净流出1.557亿美元，11月2日各基金仍是横杠，自动合计0.0不能当作已确认零流量。昨日SEC工作人员更新加密资产FAQ也只是对结构分类的说明，不是对所有质押产品一键放行。把这些不相同的信息压成一句“ETH利好”，容易忽视实际风险。

市场已经如何反应？Kraken ETH/USD最新成交约2251美元，24小时低点2233.51美元、高点2314.32美元，低于当日开盘约2272美元。我在02:40的帖子记录约2250美元，之后并无已验证的单边上涨；前帖交易计划也没有成交记录，不能倒推成我吃到了行情。2233美元是当前日内低位，2272美元是先要收回的开盘区，2314美元是上方压力。若价格跌破2233且一小时无法重新站上，短线支撑判断被推翻；若站回2272并守住，才可能重新评估。若11月6日正式就业数据明显改变利率预期，或者基金流向随后确认持续恶化，今天基于区间的判断需要重新计算。价格波动不能事后全归因于尚未发布的非农。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只考虑确认后的现货轻仓多。我会等ETH重新站上2275美元并在一小时回踩中守住，再确认没有新的官方负面公告，才用总资金最多3%试单，不加杠杆。第一目标2315美元，触及减半；第二目标2350美元，剩余仓位分批减仓。初始止损设在2230美元；若进场后跌回2260美元下方持续一小时，也主动平仓。若24小时内未触发，计划作废；到11月6日非农公布时另做独立判断。等数据是真的，比抢在标题前交易更重要。

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: ETF Outflows Weigh on Prices as Oversold Conditions Seek Support

November 2, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of November 3 Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,242, down 0.23% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly chart, ETH declined before stabilizing over the past five hours, gradually retreating from $2,273 to around $2,254, touching a low of $2,237 before edging back up to $2,255.

In terms of moving averages, Ethereum has fallen below the support of all short- and medium-term moving averages. The 7-period moving average is at $2,265, the 25-period moving average at $2,279, and the 99-period moving average at $2,259. The current price is below all of them, showing a clear bearish alignment. The EMA indicators have also weakened: the 7-period EMA is at $2,264, the 25-period EMA at $2,274, and the 99-period EMA at $2,277. The gap between the price and the moving averages is widening.

The Bollinger Bands show a lower band at $2,251, a middle band at $2,282, and an upper band at $2,313. The current price has fallen below the lower band, signaling extreme short-term weakness. However, the lower Bollinger Band often serves as a trigger zone for short-term rebounds, so it is worth watching whether the price can find solid support here.

Trading volume has declined over the past few hours, with turnover gradually shrinking from 25.36 million USDT to 3.99 million USDT. The decline in volume suggests selling pressure has eased somewhat at current price levels, but buyers are also not particularly active, leaving the market in a stalemate between bulls and bears.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

Ethereum’s momentum indicators also point to oversold conditions. The 6-period RSI is 23.63, the 12-period RSI is 34.94, and the 24-period RSI is 43.35. The short-term RSI has entered oversold territory, but has not reached the extreme levels seen in Bitcoin, indicating that ETH’s oversold conditions are relatively moderate.

The MACD line is at -4.17, the signal line at 0.70, and the histogram at -4.87. The MACD has crossed below the signal line, forming a bearish crossover, while the histogram has remained negative, indicating that bearish momentum continues to build. However, the histogram’s absolute value narrowed from -5.02 in the previous hour to -4.87, suggesting a slight loss of bearish momentum.

The KDJ indicator shows a K value of 24.89, a D value of 26.38, and a J value of 21.91. All three lines are in low territory, but the J line has started to turn upward, potentially signaling short-term rebound momentum. The Williams %R (WR) reading is -72.66. Although it remains in a weak zone, it has recovered from -75.06 in the previous hour.

Quantitative factor statistics show that 8 of 15 factors issued buy signals and 7 issued sell signals, indicating a relatively even balance between bulls and bears, with buy factors accounting for 53.3%. The composite indicator signal is bearish, with a win rate of 84.21% for sell signals and an overall win rate of 72.34%. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s bearish signals are more consistent, and their win rate is also higher, suggesting that these sell signals have historically been more reliable.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

The biggest pressure currently facing the Ethereum market comes from ETF outflows. Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of $396.6 million last week, while BlackRock’s ETHA fund alone saw outflows of approximately $1.32 billion in October. The sustained withdrawal of institutional funds over several months has clearly weighed on Ethereum’s price.

Nevertheless, the fundamentals also offer some positive signs. Bitmine added 8,573 ETH to its treasury reserves, bringing its total holdings to approximately 6.06 million ETH, or 4.96% of the circulating supply. Continued corporate accumulation provides some support at the bottom. Meanwhile, the shrinking validator exit queue suggests that pressure from staking withdrawals is easing, which could help stabilize the price floor.

On-chain, the laundering of stolen funds through the Ethereum network has drawn regulatory attention. This could lead to the risk of address-level regulatory freezes, adding further pressure to market sentiment. Losses from cryptocurrency hacks in 2026 have reached $8.74 billion—more than three times the $2.51 billion recorded in 2025—and ongoing security concerns are also affecting investor confidence.

In the short term, Ethereum has technical support in the $2,237–$2,251 range. If it can hold this zone and rebound with support from trading volume, it may challenge the Bollinger Band middle line near $2,280. However, a break below $2,237 could lead to a further decline toward the psychological $2,200 level.

以太坊的动量指标同样显示超卖状态。6周期RSI为23.63，12周期RSI为34.94，24周期RSI为43.35。短期RSI已经进入超卖区域，但尚未达到比特币那样的极端水平，说明ETH的超卖程度相对温和一些。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up paying dearly.

【Cross Margin】Your entire account balance serves as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: if the market moves to an extreme, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They all support one another in the same basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case scenario for “one bad trade

ETH at approximately $2,268 | Bitmine formally discloses adding 8,573 ETH last week | Corporate buying and ETF outflows coexist

My stance is bullish only after confirmation; I wouldn't chase at the current price. In an announcement published under the company's name on November 2, Bitmine said it held 6,060,506 ETH as of 4 p.m. ET on November 1. The chairman said in the same announcement that the company had purchased 8,573 ETH over the past week. Its previous announcement, filed with the SEC on October 26, disclosed holdings of 6,051,933 ETH as of October 25; the difference between the two holdings figures is exactly 8,573 ETH. This is an officially disclosed change in the company's holdings, not market speculation based on an executive posting an image. The company also said that 5,227,037 ETH had been staked; “already staked” describes an existing balance and should not be misreported as the amount newly staked this week.

The impact of this news on ETH's market dynamics is clear but limited. Continued buying by a publicly listed company may reduce the supply of tokens immediately available for trading and link ETH staking yields to a corporate balance sheet. But one company's purchases do not mean institutional demand across the market is recovering. Bitmine is using corporate funds and assuming price, financing, custody, and staking risks; its share price, financing capacity, and the market value of its holdings will also fluctuate with ETH. Statements in the announcement about a long-term bull market, future returns, and a target holding ratio are management's views and forecasts. They are not profits already realized, and certainly cannot be directly converted into an ETH price target.

I also checked fund flows: Farside's complete row for U.S. spot ETH funds on October 30 shows net outflows of about $155.7 million. The November 2 row still has dashes for every fund; the automatic total of 0.0 does not mean there have been no redemptions. So what can currently be confirmed is that one company continued adding to its holdings last week, while the latest complete fund trading-day data still showed net outflows. These facts point in different directions and cannot be offset to reach a conclusion of “net institutional buying.” At the time of writing, Binance's public ETH price page showed a price of about $2,268, with a 24-hour low of $2,248 and a high of $2,312. The price has not firmly moved above the range high just because of the company announcement. The market reaction can only be described as remaining within the range; one company's announcement alone cannot explain every candlestick.

If I were trading this myself: I would sit out for now and only consider a trial spot long. I would wait for ETH to close above $2,312 for two consecutive one-hour candles, then hold $2,305–$2,312 on a retest, and confirm that the next ETF breakdown is complete rather than showing dashes. Only then would I open a position using 1% of my total capital. I would sell half at $2,350, sell half of the remaining position at $2,400, and close the rest if a one-hour candle closes back below $2,312. I would set the initial stop at $2,238 and exit the entire position if it is hit, with no leverage and no adding to the position. If the price first breaks below the 24-hour low of $2,248, or if a future official company disclosure shows selling or a staking-risk event, my bullish view is invalidated and the plan is canceled; I would also immediately close any trial position. Corporate treasury buying is an important signal, but I need price action and broader fund flows to confirm that it can persist.

Sources: Bitmine company announcement dated November 2, October 26 SEC exhibit, Farside ETH fund table, Binance public ETH price page. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH约2268美元｜Bitmine正式披露上周增持8573枚｜企业买入与ETF流出并存

我的态度是看多要等确认，现价不追。Bitmine在11月2日由公司署名发布的公告称，截至美东时间11月1日16时持有6,060,506枚ETH，董事长在同一公告中说过去一周购入8,573枚。上一份已提交SEC的10月26日公告披露，截至10月25日持有6,051,933枚；两次持仓数之差正好是8,573枚。这是公司正式公开的持仓变化，不是高管发图后的市场猜测。公司还称其中5,227,037枚ETH已质押；“已质押”是存量状态，不能误写成这一周新增质押了同样数量。

这条消息对ETH的机制影响是明确但有限的。上市公司持续买入，可能减少可立即交易的筹码，并把ETH质押收益和企业资产负债表联系起来；但单家公司买入不代表全市场机构需求回暖。Bitmine以公司资金承担币价、融资、托管和质押风险，它自己的股价、融资能力和持仓市值也会随ETH波动。公告中关于长期牛市、未来收益和目标持有比例的判断属于管理层观点与预测，不能当成已经实现的利润，更不能直接换算成ETH价格目标。

我同时核了基金端：Farside的10月30日美国现货ETH基金完整行显示净流出约1.557亿美元；11月2日行仍是各基金横杠，自动合计0.0不代表已经没有赎回。于是目前可确认的是一家企业上周继续增持，以及上一完整基金交易日仍有净流出，两组事实方向不同，不能相互抵消成一个“机构净买入”结论。写稿时币安ETH公开价格页约2268美元，近24小时低2248、高2312美元，价格没有因公司公告就稳定站上区间高点。市场反应只能说仍在区间内，不能单凭一家公司公告解释每根K线。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，方向只考虑现货试多。要等ETH连续两根一小时K线收在2312美元上方，回踩2305—2312守住，并确认下一份ETF分项完整而非横杠，我才用总资金1%开仓。到2350美元减半，到2400美元再减剩余仓位的一半，余仓若一小时收回2312下方就全部平仓。初始止损设在2238美元，触及全部退出，不加杠杆、不补仓。若价格先跌破2248的近24小时低点，或后续公司正式披露出现减持、质押风险事件，偏多判断被推翻，计划取消；已试仓也立即平仓。企业财库买入是重要线索，但我需要价格和更广泛资金流一起证明它能持续。

来源：Bitmine 11月2日公司公告、10月26日SEC附件、Farside ETH基金表、币安ETH公开价格页。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。
